source.text: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְיוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן־יוֹאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In year two of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah.

en.L: In [the] second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel, Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah reigned.
en.B: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel, Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah.
en.R: Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah. It was the second year that Joash son of Jehoahaz had been king of Israel.

es.L: En el año segundo de Joás hijo de Joacaz, rey de Israel, reinó Amasías hijo de Joás, rey de Judá.
es.B: En el segundo año de Joás hijo de Joacaz, rey de Israel, Amasías hijo de Joás comenzó a reinar en Judá.
es.R: Amasías hijo de Joás comenzó a reinar en Judá. Era el segundo año del reinado de Joás hijo de Joacaz en Israel.

fr.L: En la deuxième année de Joas fils de Joachaz, roi d’Israël, Amatsia fils de Joas, roi de Juda, régna.
fr.B: La deuxième année du règne de Joas, fils de Joachaz, roi d’Israël, Amatsia, fils de Joas, devint roi de Juda.
fr.R: Amatsia fils de Joas est devenu roi de Juda. C’était la deuxième année du règne de Joas fils de Joachaz, roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa pili wa Yoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi mfalme wa Israeli, Amazia mwana wa Yoashi mfalme wa Yuda alitawala.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa pili wa Yoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi mfalme wa Israeli, Amazia mwana wa Yoashi alianza kutawala Yuda.
sw.R: Amazia mwana wa Yoashi alianza kutawala Yuda. Ilikuwa katika mwaka wa pili wa utawala wa Yoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi mfalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Năm thứ hai đời Giô-ách con trai Giô-a-cha vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, A-ma-xia con trai Giô-ách vua Giu-đa trị vì.
vi.B: Năm thứ hai đời Giô-ách con trai Giô-a-cha vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, A-ma-xia con trai Giô-ách lên làm vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: A-ma-xia con trai Giô-ách lên làm vua Giu-đa. Lúc ấy là năm thứ hai đời Giô-ách con trai Giô-a-cha làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 이스라엘 왕 여호아하스의 아들 요아스의 제2년에 유다 왕 요아스의 아들 아마샤가 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕 여호아하스의 아들 요아스가 다스린 지 2년째 되는 해에 유다 왕 요아스의 아들 아마샤가 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 유다 왕 요아스의 아들 아마샤가 왕이 되었다. 그때는 여호아하스의 아들 요아스가 이스라엘의 왕이 된 지 2년째 되는 해였다.

pt.L: No segundo ano de Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, rei de Israel, Amazias, filho de Joás, rei de Judá, reinou.
pt.B: No segundo ano de Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, rei de Israel, Amazias, filho de Joás, começou a reinar sobre Judá.
pt.R: Amazias, filho de Joás, se tornou rei de Judá. Foi no segundo ano em que Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, era rei de Israel.

decisions.choice: reigned: became king
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:1, the verb with a date marks the start of the reign. Amaziah followed his father Joash, whom his own officials had killed (12:21-22).

decisions.choice: two kings with one name: Joash of Judah and Jehoash of Israel
decisions.reason: Amaziah's father, king of Judah, and the king of Israel at this time bore the same name, which means "Yahweh has given". The Hebrew spells it in a short form (Joash) and a full form (Jehoash), and uses both for each king (verses 1, 13, 17, 23).

decisions.choice: Joash, Jehoash: the form each verse uses
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in these books, every level keeps the form of the name each verse uses. Here "Joash" names both the king of Israel and Amaziah's father; the titles "king of Israel" and "king of Judah" and the fathers' names keep the two apart (m2).

decisions.choice: two sentences, the date second
decisions.reason: Readable splits the accession formula into two sentences, as these books allow.

decisions.choice: "Joás" for Joash and Jehoash; "Amasías"
decisions.reason: Spanish writes "Joás" for both forms of the name, so the king of Judah and the king of Israel are told apart by their fathers and kingdoms (m2). "Amasías" is the usual Spanish form, as the terms note's table gives it.

decisions.choice: Joas; Amatsia
decisions.reason: The forms of the terms note; each verse keeps the name it uses, Joas or Yehoash, as the English does (m2).

decisions.choice: Giô-ách for both kings here; Giê-hô-ách where the verse says Jehoash
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the form of the name each verse uses, as the terms note sets; the titles "vua Y-sơ-ra-ên" and "vua Giu-đa" tell the two kings apart.

decisions.choice: "요아스" here for the king of Israel, as the Hebrew has the short form; "여호아스" where a verse has the long form
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps the form each verse uses, as the English does; the two kings of the same name are told apart by their titles and fathers.

decisions.choice: Jeoás (the king of Israel); Joás (Amaziah's father, the king of Judah)
alternatives: Joás for both, as the Hebrew here
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives both kings the short form of the name in this verse (m2). Portuguese keeps the rule set at 12:1 and 13:9 through the chapter (verses 1, 8-17, 23, 27): "Jeoás" is always the king of Israel and "Joás" always Amaziah's father, whichever form the Hebrew uses, so that the reader is never left to work out from the titles which king is meant.

source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֣ה בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָתֵ֨שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְהֽוֹעַדָּ֖ן מִן־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] son of twenty and five year[s] he was when he became king, and twenty and nine year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem, and [the] name of his mother [was] Jehoaddin from Jerusalem.

en.L: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and twenty-nine years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother [was] Jehoaddin from Jerusalem.
en.B: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Jehoaddin; she was from Jerusalem.
en.R: He was twenty-five years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for twenty-nine years. His mother was Jehoaddin from Jerusalem.

es.L: Tenía veinticinco años cuando comenzó a reinar, y veintinueve años reinó en Jerusalén; y el nombre de su madre [era] Joadín, de Jerusalén.
es.B: Tenía veinticinco años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó veintinueve años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Joadín y era de Jerusalén.
es.R: Tenía veinticinco años cuando llegó a ser rey, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante veintinueve años. Su madre se llamaba Joadín y era de Jerusalén.

fr.L: Il avait vingt-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna vingt-neuf ans à Jérusalem ; et le nom de sa mère [était] Yehoaddîn, de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Il avait vingt-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna vingt-neuf ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Yehoaddîn ; elle était de Jérusalem.
fr.R: Il avait vingt-cinq ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant vingt-neuf ans. Sa mère s’appelait Yehoaddîn ; elle était de Jérusalem.

sw.L: [Alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, na miaka ishirini na tisa alitawala huko Yerusalemu; na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Yehoadini wa Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka ishirini na tisa huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Yehoadini; alikuwa wa Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka ishirini na tisa. Mama yake aliitwa Yehoadini wa Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Ông [được] hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì hai mươi chín năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ ông [là] Giê-hô-a-đan, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: A-ma-xia được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì hai mươi chín năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Giê-hô-a-đan, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: A-ma-xia được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua. Ông cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem hai mươi chín năm. Mẹ vua tên là Giê-hô-a-đan, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그가 왕이 되었을 때 25세[였고], 예루살렘에서 29년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 예루살렘 출신 여호앗단이었다.
ko.B: 그는 25세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 29년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 여호앗단이었고, 예루살렘 출신이었다.
ko.R: 그는 25세에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 29년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 예루살렘 출신 여호앗단이었다.

pt.L: Ele tinha vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e vinte e nove anos reinou em Jerusalém; e o nome da sua mãe [era] Jeoadim, de Jerusalém.
pt.B: Ele tinha vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou vinte e nove anos em Jerusalém. A sua mãe se chamava Jeoadim; ela era de Jerusalém.
pt.R: Ele tinha vinte e cinco anos quando se tornou rei. Governou em Jerusalém durante vinte e nove anos. A mãe dele era Jeoadim, de Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: a son of twenty-five years: twenty-five years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years, as in 1 Kings 22:42.

decisions.choice: Jehoaddin, also spelled Jehoaddan
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) and the form the scribes marked to be read aloud (qere) spell the queen mother's name slightly differently, Jehoaddin and Jehoaddan. 2 Chronicles 25:1 has Jehoaddan. It is the same woman.

decisions.choice: the name of his mother: the queen mother
decisions.reason: For each king of Judah, Kings names the king's mother, who held an honored position at court (1 Kings 15:2, 13).

decisions.choice: twenty-five years old
decisions.reason: Every level gives the age in the normal English way (m1).

decisions.choice: "Tenía veinticinco años cuando comenzó a reinar"; "Su madre se llamaba" (B, R); "Joadín"
decisions.reason: The accession formula of Judah and the mother's name keep the terms note's wording at every level; Literal keeps the order of the Hebrew. The queen mother's name follows the written form the English uses, Jehoaddin; Joadán, the form read aloud and used in 2 Chronicles 25:1, is the alternative (m2).

decisions.choice: "Il avait N ans quand il devint roi"; "Le nom de sa mère [était]" (L), "Sa mère s'appelait" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The French accession and mother formulas of the terms note, one wording per level through Kings. Literal says "il avait ... ans" as the English Literal says "years old".

decisions.choice: The accession of a king of Judah and his mother in their fixed wording: "[alikuwa] mwana wa miaka N alipoanza kutawala" and "Na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] ..." (Literal); "alikuwa na umri wa miaka N" and "Mama yake aliitwa ..." (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: One wording per level through Kings and Chronicles, as the terms note sets it. Literal keeps the Hebrew way of giving age, "a son of N years".

decisions.choice: X được N tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì N năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem; Mẹ vua tên là
decisions.reason: The accession formula for Judah and the queen mother keep the terms note wording through Kings; Literal keeps "tên mẹ ông [là]", closer to the Hebrew "the name of his mother".

decisions.choice: The accession formula for Judah: "X는 N세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 N년 동안 다스렸다" (B); L "왕이 되었을 때 N세[였고]"; R uses the everyday "살"; the mother "그의 어머니의 이름은 ...이었다"
decisions.reason: The fixed wording of the terms note for every king of Judah. Readable counts the age with native numbers and "살", as people say it.

decisions.choice: Jeoadim
decisions.reason: The queen mother's name follows the written form the English follows (m2), in Portuguese spelling, with "-im" for the final "-in"; the meaning note gives the other spelling. The Hebrew says "he was" here, so Literal needs no bracket for "tinha".

source.text: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה רַ֕ק לֹ֖א כְּדָוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו כְּכֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֛ה יוֹאָ֥שׁ אָבִ֖יו עָשָֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh, only not like David his father; according to all that had done Joash his father he did.

en.L: And he did the right in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, only not like David his father; according to all that Joash his father had done, he did.
en.B: He did what was right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, yet not as his ancestor David had done. He did everything just as his father Joash had done.
en.R: Amaziah did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was right, but he was not like his ancestor David. He did everything his father Joash had done.

es.L: E hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, aunque no como David su padre; hizo conforme a todo lo que había hecho Joás su padre.
es.B: Hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, aunque no como su antepasado David. Hizo en todo lo mismo que había hecho su padre Joás.
es.R: Amasías hizo lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, pero no fue como su antepasado David. Hizo todo lo que había hecho su padre Joás.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, seulement pas comme David son père ; il fit selon tout ce qu’avait fait Joas son père.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est juste aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, mais pas comme son ancêtre David. Il agit en tout comme son père Joas avait agi.
fr.R: Amatsia a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare bon, mais il n’a pas été comme son ancêtre David. Il a fait tout ce que son père Joas avait fait.

sw.L: Naye akafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ila si kama Daudi baba yake; alifanya sawasawa na yote aliyoyafanya Yoashi baba yake.
sw.B: Alifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini si kama babu yake Daudi alivyofanya. Alifanya kila kitu kama baba yake Yoashi alivyofanya.
sw.R: Amazia alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mema, lakini hakuwa kama babu yake Daudi. Alifanya kila kitu ambacho baba yake Yoashi alikuwa amefanya.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chỉ không như Đa-vít tổ phụ ông; ông làm theo mọi điều Giô-ách cha ông đã làm.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ngay thẳng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhưng không bằng Đa-vít tổ tiên ông. Ông làm mọi điều đúng như Giô-ách cha ông đã làm.
vi.R: A-ma-xia làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là phải, nhưng ông không giống Đa-vít tổ tiên mình. Ông làm mọi điều Giô-ách cha ông đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 올바른 일을 했으나, 그의 조상 다윗과 같지는 않았다. 그는 그의 아버지 요아스가 한 모든 일대로 했다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 올바른 일을 했으나, 그의 조상 다윗만큼은 하지 못했다. 그는 모든 일을 그의 아버지 요아스가 한 대로 했다.
ko.R: 아마샤는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했다. 그러나 그는 그의 조상 다윗과 같지는 않았다. 그는 그의 아버지 요아스가 한 일을 그대로 다 했다.

pt.L: E fez o reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, somente não como Davi, seu pai; conforme tudo o que Joás, seu pai, tinha feito, ele fez.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, mas não como o seu antepassado Davi. Fez tudo exatamente como o seu pai Joás tinha feito.
pt.R: Amazias fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava certo, mas não foi como o seu antepassado Davi. Ele fez tudo o que o seu pai Joás tinha feito.

decisions.choice: did what was right, only not like David: a good verdict with a limit
decisions.reason: Amaziah receives the good verdict, but David is the measure, and he falls short of it. Like his father Joash (12:3-4), he left the high places standing (verse 4).

decisions.choice: David his father: his ancestor David
decisions.reason: "Father" also means a forefather. Kings measures each king of Judah against David (1 Kings 15:3, 11).

decisions.choice: did the right in [the] eyes of / did what was right in the sight of / did what the LORD said was right
decisions.reason: The good verdict is worded the same way at each level throughout these books. Readable names Amaziah at the start of the verdict.

decisions.choice: his ancestor David
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "ancestor" where David is called the father of a later king (m2); Literal keeps "father".

decisions.choice: "hizo lo recto a los ojos del SEÑOR" (L, B); "hizo lo que agrada al SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: The good verdict keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: "su antepasado David"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "antepasado" where David is called the father of a later king (m2); Literal keeps "padre".

decisions.choice: "fit ce qui est droit aux yeux du SEIGNEUR" (L), "juste" (B), "a fait ce que le SEIGNEUR déclare bon" (R)
decisions.reason: The fixed wording of the good verdict through Kings, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: alifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa BWANA (Literal, Balanced); alifanya yale BWANA aliyoyaona kuwa mema (Readable); babu yake Daudi
decisions.reason: The good verdict in its fixed wording from the terms note. Balanced and Readable call David "babu yake", his ancestor, as the English does; "babu" in Swahili covers a forefather further back than a grandfather.

decisions.choice: làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt CHÚA (L); trước mặt CHÚA (B); làm điều CHÚA cho là phải (R); tổ phụ / tổ tiên
decisions.reason: The good verdict keeps the terms note wording at each level through Kings. David, called his "father", is "tổ phụ" (L) and "tổ tiên" (B, R), since Vietnamese "cha" would mislead.

decisions.choice: "주의 눈에 올바른 일을 했다" (L), "주 보시기에 올바른 일을 했다" (B), "주께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했다" (R); "그의 조상 다윗" at every level
decisions.reason: The good verdict of the terms note. "Father" here means forefather; Korean "아버지" would mislead even at Literal, so "조상" is used at every level.

source.text: רַ֥ק הַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹא־סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָעָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Only the high places not were removed; still the people [were] sacrificing and making smoke at the high places.

en.L: Only the high places were not removed; the people were still sacrificing and burning incense at the high places.
en.B: Yet the high places were not taken away; the people still offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places.
en.R: But the hilltop shrines were not removed. The people still offered sacrifices and burned incense at the hilltop shrines.

es.L: Solo que los lugares altos no fueron quitados; el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en los lugares altos.
es.B: Sin embargo, los lugares altos no fueron quitados; el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en los lugares altos.
es.R: Pero los santuarios sobre las colinas no fueron quitados. El pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en esos santuarios sobre las colinas.

fr.L: Seulement les hauts lieux ne furent pas supprimés ; le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens sur les hauts lieux.
fr.B: Cependant les hauts lieux ne disparurent pas ; le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens sur les hauts lieux.
fr.R: Mais les sanctuaires sur les collines n’ont pas été supprimés. Le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens dans ces sanctuaires.

sw.L: Ila mahali pa juu hapakuondolewa; watu walikuwa bado wakitoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba mahali pa juu.
sw.B: Lakini mahali pa juu hapakuondolewa; watu waliendelea kutoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba mahali pa juu.
sw.R: Lakini patakatifu pa kilimani hapakuondolewa. Watu waliendelea kutoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba katika patakatifu pa kilimani.

vi.L: Chỉ có các nơi cao không bị dẹp bỏ; dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế và đốt hương trên các nơi cao.
vi.B: Tuy nhiên, các nơi cao không bị dẹp bỏ; dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế và đốt hương trên các nơi cao.
vi.R: Nhưng các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao không bị dẹp bỏ. Dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế và đốt hương tại các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao.

ko.L: 다만 산당들은 없어지지 않았다. 백성이 여전히 산당들에서 제사를 드리고 분향하고 있었다.
ko.B: 그러나 산당들은 없어지지 않아서 백성은 여전히 산당에서 제사를 드리고 분향했다.
ko.R: 그러나 산꼭대기 제단들은 없애지 않았다. 백성은 여전히 산꼭대기 제단에서 제사를 드리고 향을 피웠다.

pt.L: Somente os altos não foram removidos; o povo ainda sacrificava e queimava incenso nos altos.
pt.B: Os altos, porém, não foram removidos. O povo ainda oferecia sacrifícios e queimava incenso nos altos.
pt.R: Mas os santuários no alto dos morros não foram removidos. O povo continuava oferecendo sacrifícios e queimando incenso nesses santuários.

decisions.choice: the high places: local places of worship
decisions.reason: High places were local shrines, often on hills, with an altar. Even when they were used to worship Yahweh, sacrifice there went against the law's demand to worship at the one place Yahweh chose (Deuteronomy 12:13-14). The same was said of Joash (12:4) and of Jehoshaphat (1 Kings 22:44).

decisions.choice: making smoke: burning offerings, or burning incense
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke, either incense or parts of an offering. With "sacrificing" it describes the regular worship at the shrines, as in 1 Kings 22:44.

decisions.choice: hilltop shrines
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced say "high places"; Readable says "hilltop shrines", as these books do throughout.

decisions.choice: "los lugares altos" (L, B); "los santuarios sobre las colinas" (R)
decisions.reason: The high-places formula keeps the terms note's wording through Kings; Readable says "santuarios sobre las colinas", as the English says "hilltop shrines".

decisions.choice: "les hauts lieux ne furent pas supprimés" (L), "ne disparurent pas" (B); "les sanctuaires sur les collines" (R)
decisions.reason: The high-places formula of the terms note; Readable explains the term as the English "hilltop shrines" does.

decisions.choice: mahali pa juu (Literal, Balanced); patakatifu pa kilimani (Readable)
decisions.reason: The high places in the terms note's wording, used through Kings.

decisions.choice: các nơi cao (L, B); các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao (R)
decisions.reason: The high places formula keeps the terms note wording; Readable says what a high place was.

decisions.choice: "산당" (L, B); "산꼭대기 제단" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the high places and the formula "산당들은 없어지지 않아서 백성은 여전히 산당에서 제사를 드리고 분향했다"; Readable says what a high place was.

source.text: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר חָזְקָ֥ה הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־עֲבָדָ֔יו הַמַּכִּ֖ים אֶת־הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when was strong the kingdom in his hand, and he struck down his servants, the [ones] striking down the king his father.

en.L: And it happened, as soon as the kingdom was firm in his hand, that he struck down his servants who had struck down the king his father.
en.B: As soon as the kingdom was firmly in his control, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.
en.R: As soon as Amaziah had firm control of the kingdom, he put to death the officials who had killed his father, the king.

es.L: Y sucedió que, en cuanto el reino se afirmó en su mano, hirió a sus siervos, los que habían herido al rey su padre.
es.B: En cuanto tuvo el reino firmemente bajo su control, ejecutó a los funcionarios que habían asesinado a su padre, el rey.
es.R: En cuanto Amasías tuvo el control firme del reino, mandó matar a los funcionarios que habían matado a su padre, el rey.

fr.L: Et il arriva, dès que la royauté fut affermie dans sa main, qu’il frappa ses serviteurs qui avaient frappé le roi son père.
fr.B: Dès que la royauté fut solidement entre ses mains, il fit exécuter les officiers qui avaient assassiné le roi son père.
fr.R: Dès qu’Amatsia a eu le pouvoir bien en main, il a fait mourir les officiers qui avaient tué son père, le roi.

sw.L: Ikawa, mara ufalme ulipokuwa imara mkononi mwake, akawapiga watumishi wake waliompiga mfalme baba yake.
sw.B: Mara ufalme ulipokuwa imara chini ya mamlaka yake, aliwaua maafisa wale waliomwua baba yake mfalme.
sw.R: Mara Amazia alipokwisha kuushika ufalme kwa uthabiti, aliwaua maafisa waliokuwa wamemwua baba yake, mfalme.

vi.L: Xảy ra, ngay khi vương quốc được vững chắc trong tay ông, ông giết các đầy tớ của mình là những kẻ đã giết vua cha.
vi.B: Ngay khi vương quốc đã vững vàng trong tay, A-ma-xia xử tử các triều thần đã ám sát vua cha.
vi.R: Ngay khi A-ma-xia nắm vững quyền cai trị vương quốc, ông xử tử các quan chức đã giết cha mình là vua.

ko.L: 그리고 나라가 그의 손에 굳게 서자, 그가 왕인 그의 아버지를 쳐 죽인 그의 신하들을 쳐 죽였다.
ko.B: 나라가 그의 손안에 확고해지자, 그는 왕인 자기 아버지를 살해한 신하들을 처형했다.
ko.R: 아마샤는 나라를 확실히 다스리게 되자, 왕이었던 자기 아버지를 죽인 신하들을 사형에 처했다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, logo que o reino se firmou na sua mão, ele feriu os seus escravos que tinham ferido o rei, seu pai.
pt.B: Assim que o reino ficou firme nas suas mãos, ele executou os oficiais que tinham assassinado o seu pai, o rei.
pt.R: Assim que Amazias teve o controle firme do reino, ele mandou matar os oficiais que tinham matado o seu pai, o rei.

decisions.choice: the kingdom was firm in his hand: his rule was secure
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for power. Amaziah waited until his hold on the throne was secure before he acted against the men who had killed his father.

decisions.choice: the officials who had struck down the king: Jozabad and Jehozabad
decisions.reason: These are the two officials who killed Joash in a conspiracy (12:21-22).

decisions.choice: struck down: killed
decisions.reason: The same verb is used both for the murder of Joash and for Amaziah's punishment of the killers. Both times it means putting to death.

decisions.choice: officials (Balanced, Readable); servants (Literal)
decisions.reason: These were royal officials, not household slaves, so Balanced and Readable call them officials, as these books do for a king's servants at court.

decisions.choice: executed ... murdered (Balanced); put to death ... killed (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses two words for the one Hebrew verb, to show that the first killing was a crime and the second a punishment.

decisions.choice: "funcionarios"; "ejecutó ... asesinado" (B); "mandó matar ... habían matado" (R)
decisions.reason: These were royal officials, so Balanced and Readable say "funcionarios"; Literal keeps "siervos". Balanced, like the English, uses two verbs for the one Hebrew verb to show that the first killing was a crime and the second a punishment.

decisions.choice: "serviteurs" (L); "officiers" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The king's servants are "les serviteurs du roi" at Literal and "les officiers du roi" at Balanced and Readable, as the Samuel terms note sets.

decisions.choice: watumishi (Literal); maafisa (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The king's servants as in Samuel: "watumishi" at Literal, "maafisa" (officials) at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: triều thần (B); quan chức (R); xử tử ... ám sát (B)
decisions.reason: These were royal officials, so Balanced and Readable do not call them servants; Balanced uses two verbs, "xử tử" and "ám sát", for the one Hebrew verb, as the English does.

source.text: וְאֶת־בְּנֵ֥י הַמַּכִּ֖ים לֹ֣א הֵמִ֑ית כַּכָּת֣וּב בְּסֵ֣פֶר תּֽוֹרַת־מֹ֠שֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹא־יוּמְת֨וּ אָב֤וֹת עַל־בָּנִים֙ וּבָנִים֙ לֹא־יוּמְת֣וּ עַל־אָב֔וֹת כִּ֛י אִם־אִ֥ישׁ בְּחֶטְא֖וֹ יוּמָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And the sons of the [ones] striking down not he put to death, according to [what is] written in [the] book of [the] law of Moses which commanded Yahweh, saying, Not will be put to death fathers on account of sons, and sons not will be put to death on account of fathers, but [each] man for his sin will be put to death.

en.L: But the {{gender:children|sons}} of those who struck him down he did not put to death, according to what is written in the book of the law of Moses, which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded, saying, "{{gender:Parents|Fathers}} shall not be put to death for {{gender:children|sons}}, and {{gender:children|sons}} shall not be put to death for {{gender:parents|fathers}}; but each shall be put to death for {{gender:their|his}} own sin."
en.B: But he did not put to death the {{gender:children|sons}} of the murderers. In this he kept to the book of the law of Moses, in which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded, "{{gender:Parents|Fathers}} are not to be put to death for their {{gender:children|sons}}, nor {{gender:children|sons}} for their {{gender:parents|fathers}}. Each one is to be put to death only for {{gender:their|his}} own sin."
en.R: But he did not kill the {{gender:children|sons}} of the murderers. He obeyed what is written in the book of the law of Moses. There {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded, "Do not put {{gender:parents|fathers}} to death for what their {{gender:children|sons}} have done. Do not put {{gender:children|sons}} to death for what their {{gender:parents|fathers}} have done. People may be put to death only for their own sin."

es.L: Pero a los hijos de los que lo habían herido no les dio muerte, conforme a lo que está escrito en el libro de la ley de Moisés, que mandó {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, diciendo: «No morirán los padres por los hijos, ni los hijos morirán por los padres; sino que cada uno morirá por su propio pecado».
es.B: Pero no dio muerte a los hijos de los asesinos. En esto se atuvo al libro de la ley de Moisés, en el que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mandó: «No se dará muerte a los padres por sus hijos, ni a los hijos por sus padres. Cada uno morirá solo por su propio pecado».
es.R: Pero no mató a los hijos de los asesinos. Obedeció lo que está escrito en el libro de la ley de Moisés. Allí {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mandó: «No mates a los padres por lo que hayan hecho sus hijos. No mates a los hijos por lo que hayan hecho sus padres. Cada uno solo puede morir por su propio pecado».

fr.L: Mais les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de ceux qui l’avaient frappé, il ne les fit pas mourir, selon ce qui est écrit dans le livre de la loi de Moïse, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a prescrit en disant : « Les {{gender:parents|pères}} ne seront pas mis à mort pour les {{gender:enfants|fils}}, et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} ne seront pas mis à mort pour les {{gender:parents|pères}} ; mais chacun sera mis à mort pour son propre péché. »
fr.B: Mais il ne fit pas mourir les {{gender:enfants|fils}} des meurtriers. Il s’en tint en cela au livre de la loi de Moïse, où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a prescrit : « On ne fera pas mourir les {{gender:parents|pères}} pour leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}}, ni les {{gender:enfants|fils}} pour leurs {{gender:parents|pères}}. Chacun sera mis à mort seulement pour son propre péché. »
fr.R: Mais il n’a pas fait mourir les {{gender:enfants|fils}} des meurtriers. Il a obéi à ce qui est écrit dans le livre de la loi de Moïse. Là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné cet ordre : « Ne faites pas mourir les {{gender:parents|pères}} pour ce que leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} ont fait. Ne faites pas mourir les {{gender:enfants|fils}} pour ce que leurs {{gender:parents|pères}} ont fait. On ne peut faire mourir quelqu’un que pour son propre péché. »

sw.L: Lakini wana wa wale waliompiga hakuwaua, sawasawa na ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha Sheria ya Musa, ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliamuru, akisema, "Baba hawatauawa kwa ajili ya wana, wala wana hawatauawa kwa ajili ya baba; bali kila mtu atauawa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe."
sw.B: Lakini hakuwaua watoto wa wauaji hao. Katika hilo alishika kitabu cha Sheria ya Musa, ambamo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliamuru, "Wazazi wasiuawe kwa ajili ya watoto wao, wala watoto wasiuawe kwa ajili ya wazazi wao. Kila mtu atauawa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe tu."
sw.R: Lakini hakuwaua watoto wa wauaji hao. Alitii yale yaliyoandikwa katika kitabu cha Sheria ya Musa. Humo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliamuru, "Msiwaue wazazi kwa sababu ya yale waliyofanya watoto wao. Msiwaue watoto kwa sababu ya yale waliyofanya wazazi wao. Mtu anaweza kuuawa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe tu."

vi.L: Nhưng con cái của những kẻ giết vua thì ông không xử tử, theo điều đã chép trong sách luật pháp Môi-se mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền rằng: "{{gender:Cha mẹ|Cha}} sẽ không bị xử tử vì {{gender:con cái|con}}, và {{gender:con cái|con}} sẽ không bị xử tử vì {{gender:cha mẹ|cha}}; nhưng mỗi người sẽ bị xử tử vì tội của chính mình."
vi.B: Nhưng ông không xử tử con cái của những kẻ ám sát. Như vậy ông làm theo sách luật pháp Môi-se, trong đó {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền: "{{gender:Cha mẹ|Cha}} không bị xử tử vì {{gender:con cái|con}}, {{gender:con cái|con}} cũng không bị xử tử vì {{gender:cha mẹ|cha}}. Mỗi người chỉ bị xử tử vì tội của chính mình."
vi.R: Nhưng ông không giết con cái của những kẻ ám sát. Ông vâng theo điều đã chép trong sách luật pháp Môi-se. Ở đó {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền: "Đừng xử tử {{gender:cha mẹ|cha}} vì điều {{gender:con cái|con}} đã làm. Đừng xử tử {{gender:con cái|con}} vì điều {{gender:cha mẹ|cha}} đã làm. Mỗi người chỉ bị xử tử vì tội của chính mình."

ko.L: 그러나 그는 쳐 죽인 자들의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들은 죽이지 않았다. 이는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 명령하신 모세의 율법책에 기록된 대로였다. "{{gender:부모|아버지}}들은 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들 때문에 죽임을 당하지 않을 것이고, {{gender:자녀|아들}}들은 {{gender:부모|아버지}}들 때문에 죽임을 당하지 않을 것이다. 오직 각 사람은 자기 죄 때문에 죽임을 당할 것이다."
ko.B: 그러나 그는 살해자들의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들은 죽이지 않았다. 이 일에서 그는 모세의 율법책을 지켰는데, 거기에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 명령하셨다. "{{gender:부모|아버지}}들이 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들 때문에 죽임을 당해서는 안 되고, {{gender:자녀|아들}}들이 {{gender:부모|아버지}}들 때문에 죽임을 당해서도 안 된다. 사람은 각자 자기 죄 때문에만 죽임을 당해야 한다."
ko.R: 그러나 그는 살해자들의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들은 죽이지 않았다. 그는 모세의 율법책에 기록된 말씀을 따랐다. 거기에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 명령하셨다. "{{gender:자녀|아들}}들이 한 일 때문에 {{gender:부모|아버지}}들을 죽이지 마라. {{gender:부모|아버지}}들이 한 일 때문에 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들을 죽이지 마라. 사람은 자기가 지은 죄 때문에만 죽임을 당해야 한다."

pt.L: Mas os filhos dos que o feriram ele não matou, conforme o que está escrito no livro da Lei de Moisés, que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ordenou, dizendo: "Os pais não serão mortos pelos filhos, e os filhos não serão mortos pelos pais; mas cada um será morto pelo seu próprio pecado."
pt.B: Mas ele não matou os filhos dos assassinos. Nisso seguiu o livro da Lei de Moisés, no qual {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ordenou: "Os pais não serão mortos por causa dos filhos, nem os filhos por causa dos pais. Cada um será morto somente pelo seu próprio pecado."
pt.R: Mas ele não matou os filhos dos assassinos. Ele obedeceu ao que está escrito no livro da Lei de Moisés. Ali {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ordenou: "Não condenes à morte os pais pelo que os filhos fizeram. Não condenes à morte os filhos pelo que os pais fizeram. Uma pessoa só pode ser condenada à morte pelo seu próprio pecado."

decisions.choice: a quotation of Deuteronomy 24:16
decisions.reason: The law quoted is Deuteronomy 24:16, and the wording here follows that verse. Kings adds "but" before the last clause and makes its verb singular ("each shall be put to death"), where Deuteronomy has "they shall be put to death". The sense is the same: a court may punish only the guilty person. 2 Chronicles 25:4 quotes the same law.

decisions.choice: the book of the law of Moses: the written law, here Deuteronomy
decisions.reason: Moses wrote down the law and gave it to the priests (Deuteronomy 31:9, 24-26). The writer notes that Amaziah kept a written command, unlike the usual practice of kings who wiped out a rival's whole family (1 Kings 15:29; 16:11; 2 Kings 10:6-11).

decisions.choice: sons ... fathers: children and parents
decisions.reason: In the law the words cover parents and children of either sex, as in Deuteronomy 24:16. The killers' children are named with the same word the law uses.

decisions.choice: shall be put to death
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) could be read "shall die"; the form the scribes marked to be read aloud (qere) is "shall be put to death", which matches the rest of the law. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: the wording of Deuteronomy 24:16; Parents / children; their
decisions.reason: Each level quotes the law in the words it uses at Deuteronomy 24:16, with "but" added at Literal for the Hebrew addition (m1). The gender setting gives "parents", "children" and "their" by default and "fathers", "sons" and "his" as the alternative (m3).

decisions.choice: "padres", "hijos", "su" with no gender setting
decisions.reason: Spanish "padres" already means parents, and "hijos" and "su" cover sons and daughters, so the law of Deuteronomy 24:16 needs no gender span in Spanish, as the Psalms terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "parents" / "pères"; "enfants" / "fils"; no span on "son propre péché"
decisions.reason: As the English, the inclusive default says parents and children, with the Hebrew's fathers and sons as the alternative. French "chacun ... son" already includes everyone, so it needs no span where the English has "their / his".

decisions.choice: baba ... wana (Literal); wazazi ... watoto (Balanced, Readable); no gender span
decisions.reason: The law means parents and children (meaning decision m3). Literal keeps the Hebrew nouns, Balanced and Readable say "wazazi" and "watoto", which already cover both men and women; as elsewhere in the Swahili, no gender span is used.

decisions.choice: {{gender:cha mẹ|cha}}; {{gender:con cái|con}}
alternatives: cha mẹ / con cái with no span
decisions.reason: Here Vietnamese truly has two wordings: "cha" and "con" follow the Hebrew's "fathers" and "sons", "cha mẹ" and "con cái" its sense (m3), so the law takes the gender span as the English does. "Con cái của những kẻ giết vua" already covers sons and daughters and takes none.

decisions.choice: gender spans with "자녀" / "아들" and "부모" / "아버지", always followed by the plural "들" so one particle fits both wordings
decisions.reason: Here Korean really has two wordings, as the English does: the law covers parents and children, and the alternative keeps the Hebrew's "fathers" and "sons". 각 사람 already includes everyone.

decisions.choice: the wording of Deuteronomy 24:16 in Portuguese; os pais / os filhos with no gender setting; "Não condenes" (R)
decisions.reason: Each level quotes the law in the words Deuteronomy 24:16 has in Portuguese, with "mas" added at Literal for the Hebrew addition (m1). Portuguese "pais" already means parents and "filhos" children of either sex (m3), so the English gender setting has no second wording to offer. Readable keeps the commandment's "tu" ("Não condenes"), as the law is worded in Deuteronomy.

source.text: הוּא־הִכָּ֨ה אֶת־אֱד֤וֹם בְּגֵיא־מֶ֨לַח֙ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְתָפַ֥שׂ אֶת־הַסֶּ֖לַע בַּמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־שְׁמָהּ֙ יָקְתְאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: He struck down Edom in [the] Valley of Salt, ten thousand, and he seized the Sela in the battle, and he called its name Joktheel until this day.

en.L: He struck down Edom in the Valley of Salt, 10,000, and took Sela in battle, and called its name Joktheel to this day.
en.B: He defeated the Edomites in the Valley of Salt, 10,000 of them, and captured Sela in battle. He named it Joktheel, and it is called that to this day.
en.R: Amaziah defeated the Edomites in the Valley of Salt and killed 10,000 of them. He also captured the town of Sela in battle and gave it the name Joktheel. It still has that name to this day.

es.L: Él hirió a Edom en el valle de la Sal, 10 000, y tomó Sela en la batalla, y le puso por nombre Jocteel hasta el día de hoy.
es.B: Derrotó a los edomitas en el valle de la Sal, 10 000 de ellos, y tomó Sela en la batalla. Le puso el nombre de Jocteel, y así se llama hasta el día de hoy.
es.R: Amasías derrotó a los edomitas en el valle de la Sal y mató a 10 000 de ellos. También conquistó en batalla la ciudad de Sela y le puso el nombre de Jocteel. Todavía se llama así hasta el día de hoy.

fr.L: Il frappa Édom dans la vallée du Sel, dix mille [hommes], et il prit Séla dans la bataille, et il l’appela du nom de Yoqtéel jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: Il battit les Édomites dans la vallée du Sel, au nombre de dix mille, et il prit Séla par les armes. Il lui donna le nom de Yoqtéel, qu’elle porte jusqu’à aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Amatsia a battu les Édomites dans la vallée du Sel et il en a tué dix mille. Il s’est aussi emparé de la ville de Séla au cours d’une bataille, et il l’a appelée Yoqtéel. Elle porte encore ce nom aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Yeye aliwapiga Edomu katika Bonde la Chumvi, elfu kumi, akaitwaa Sela katika vita, akaliita jina lake Yoktheeli mpaka siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: Aliwashinda Waedomu katika Bonde la Chumvi, watu 10,000 kati yao, akauteka mji wa Sela vitani. Akauita Yoktheeli, nao unaitwa hivyo mpaka leo.
sw.R: Amazia aliwashinda Waedomu katika Bonde la Chumvi, akawaua 10,000 kati yao. Pia aliuteka mji wa Sela vitani, akaupa jina Yoktheeli. Mpaka leo bado unaitwa jina hilo.

vi.L: Ông đánh Ê-đôm tại thung lũng Muối, mười nghìn [người], và chiếm Sê-la trong trận chiến, rồi đặt tên nó là Giốc-thê-ên cho đến ngày nay.
vi.B: Ông đánh bại người Ê-đôm tại thung lũng Muối, giết mười nghìn người, và chiếm Sê-la trong trận chiến. Ông đặt tên thành ấy là Giốc-thê-ên, và nó mang tên ấy cho đến ngày nay.
vi.R: A-ma-xia đánh bại người Ê-đôm tại thung lũng Muối và giết mười nghìn người. Ông cũng chiếm được thành Sê-la trong trận chiến và đặt tên nó là Giốc-thê-ên. Thành ấy vẫn mang tên đó cho đến ngày nay.

ko.L: 그가 소금 골짜기에서 에돔을, 만 명을 쳐 죽였고, 전쟁으로 셀라를 점령하여 그 이름을 욕드엘이라고 불렀다. 오늘날까지 [그러하다].
ko.B: 그는 소금 골짜기에서 에돔 사람 만 명을 쳐 죽였고, 전쟁을 벌여 셀라를 점령했다. 그는 그곳을 욕드엘이라고 불렀는데, 오늘날까지 그렇게 불린다.
ko.R: 아마샤는 소금 골짜기에서 에돔 사람들을 쳐서 만 명을 죽였다. 그는 또 전쟁을 벌여 셀라 성읍을 빼앗고, 그곳의 이름을 욕드엘이라고 지었다. 그곳은 오늘날까지 그 이름으로 불린다.

pt.L: Ele feriu Edom no vale do Sal, dez mil, e tomou Sela na batalha, e chamou o seu nome Jocteel até este dia.
pt.B: Ele derrotou os edomitas no vale do Sal, dez mil deles, e conquistou Sela na batalha. Ele lhe deu o nome de Jocteel, e assim ela é chamada até hoje.
pt.R: Amazias derrotou os edomitas no vale do Sal e matou dez mil deles. Também conquistou a cidade de Sela na batalha e lhe deu o nome de Jocteel. Ela ainda tem esse nome até hoje.

decisions.choice: Edom in the Valley of Salt
decisions.reason: Edom had broken free of Judah in the days of Jehoram (8:20-22). The Valley of Salt, probably near the south end of the Dead Sea, is where David had defeated Edom (2 Samuel 8:13). 2 Chronicles 25:11-12 tells this campaign at more length.

decisions.choice: Sela: an Edomite stronghold whose site is not certain
decisions.reason: The name means "the rock". It was a fortress in the rocky hills of Edom. Its exact place is not known.

decisions.choice: Joktheel: a new name that marked the conquest
decisions.reason: Giving a captured town a new name showed that it now belonged to the one who named it. The meaning of the name is not certain; it may mean something like "God subdues".

decisions.choice: to this day: the writer's own time
decisions.reason: As in 2:22, "to this day" means up to the time when this account was written. The new name was still in use then.

decisions.choice: struck down ten thousand: killed ten thousand
decisions.reason: With a number of men, the verb means that they were killed in battle.

decisions.choice: the Edomites; 10,000 of them; the town of Sela
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the people for the nation "Edom" and write the number in figures. Readable says what Sela was. Literal keeps the Hebrew order, which puts the number at the end.

decisions.choice: "Sela", "Jocteel"; "hasta el día de hoy"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish forms of the names; "hasta el día de hoy" is the terms note's wording for the writer's own day at every level.

decisions.choice: "jusqu'à ce jour" (L); "jusqu'à aujourd'hui" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The writer's "to this day" in the wording the terms note sets for Kings.

decisions.choice: mpaka siku hii ya leo (Literal); mpaka leo (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The writer's "to this day" in the terms note's wording.

decisions.choice: cho đến ngày nay
decisions.reason: "To this day", the writer's own day, is "cho đến ngày nay" at every level, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "오늘날까지" for "to this day"
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the writer's own day, kept at every level through Kings.

decisions.choice: o vale do Sal; Sela; Jocteel; dez mil in words
decisions.reason: "O vale do Sal" as 2 Samuel 8:13 has it in Portuguese (m1), and "Sela" as Judges 1:36. The new name (m3) is written "Jocteel", with "c" for the hard sound before "t". The round number is written in words at every level, as in 13:7, where the English uses figures.

source.text: אָ֣ז שָׁלַ֤ח אֲמַצְיָה֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־יְהוֹאָ֨שׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָ֧ז בֶּן־יֵה֛וּא מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לְכָ֖ה נִתְרָאֶ֥ה פָנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Then sent Amaziah messengers to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look at one another [in the] face.

en.L: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, "Come, let us look one another in the face."
en.B: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, to say, "Come, let us meet face to face."
en.R: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash king of Israel, the son of Jehoahaz and grandson of Jehu. They said, "Come out and face me in battle."

es.L: Entonces Amasías envió mensajeros a Joás hijo de Joacaz, hijo de Jehú, rey de Israel, diciendo: «Ven, mirémonos cara a cara».
es.B: Entonces Amasías envió mensajeros a Joás hijo de Joacaz, hijo de Jehú, rey de Israel, para decirle: «Ven, enfrentémonos cara a cara».
es.R: Entonces Amasías envió mensajeros a Joás, rey de Israel, hijo de Joacaz y nieto de Jehú. Le dijeron: «Sal a enfrentarte conmigo en batalla».

fr.L: Alors Amatsia envoya des messagers à Yehoash fils de Joachaz fils de Jéhu, roi d’Israël, pour dire : « Viens, regardons-nous en face ! »
fr.B: Alors Amatsia envoya des messagers à Yehoash, fils de Joachaz, fils de Jéhu, roi d’Israël, pour lui dire : « Viens, mesurons-nous face à face ! »
fr.R: Ensuite Amatsia a envoyé des messagers à Yehoash, roi d’Israël, le fils de Joachaz et petit-fils de Jéhu. Ils lui ont dit : « Viens m’affronter au combat ! »

sw.L: Ndipo Amazia akatuma wajumbe kwa Yehoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi mwana wa Yehu, mfalme wa Israeli, akisema, "Njoo, tutazamane uso kwa uso."
sw.B: Kisha Amazia alituma wajumbe kwa Yehoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi mwana wa Yehu, mfalme wa Israeli, kumwambia, "Njoo, tukutane uso kwa uso."
sw.R: Kisha Amazia alituma wajumbe kwa Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli, mwana wa Yehoahazi na mjukuu wa Yehu. Walisema, "Njoo tupigane vita."

vi.L: Bấy giờ A-ma-xia sai sứ giả đến Giê-hô-ách con trai Giô-a-cha, con trai Giê-hu, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, nói: "Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy nhìn mặt nhau."
vi.B: Bấy giờ A-ma-xia sai sứ giả đến nói với Giê-hô-ách con trai Giô-a-cha, cháu Giê-hu, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy đối mặt nhau."
vi.R: Rồi A-ma-xia sai sứ giả đến gặp Giê-hô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, con trai Giô-a-cha và cháu nội Giê-hu. Họ nói: "Hãy ra đây giao chiến với ta."

ko.L: 그때 아마샤가 예후의 손자 여호아하스의 아들 이스라엘 왕 여호아스에게 사자들을 보내어 말했다. "오너라, 우리가 서로 얼굴을 마주 보자."
ko.B: 그때 아마샤가 예후의 손자요 여호아하스의 아들인 이스라엘 왕 여호아스에게 사자들을 보내어 말했다. "자, 우리 한번 얼굴을 맞대고 겨루어 보자."
ko.R: 그때 아마샤는 이스라엘 왕 여호아스에게 사자들을 보냈다. 여호아스는 여호아하스의 아들이고 예후의 손자였다. 사자들이 말했다. "나와서 나와 싸워 보자."

pt.L: Então Amazias enviou mensageiros a Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, filho de Jeú, rei de Israel, dizendo: "Venha, vamos nos ver face a face."
pt.B: Então Amazias enviou mensageiros a Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, filho de Jeú, rei de Israel, para dizer: "Venha, vamos nos encontrar face a face."
pt.R: Então Amazias enviou mensageiros a Jeoás, rei de Israel, filho de Jeoacaz e neto de Jeú. Eles disseram: "Venha me enfrentar numa batalha."

decisions.choice: let us look one another in the face: a challenge to fight
decisions.reason: Verse 11 shows what the words mean: the two kings meet in battle. Amaziah, proud after his victory over Edom (verse 10), challenges Israel to war.

decisions.choice: then: after the victory over Edom
decisions.reason: "Then" ties the challenge to the victory of verse 7. 2 Chronicles 25:6-13 adds that Israelite soldiers Amaziah had hired and sent home had raided towns of Judah.

decisions.choice: son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu
decisions.reason: Jehoash was the grandson of Jehu, who had seized the throne of Israel (9:1-10:36). Jehu's line was promised four generations (10:30).

decisions.choice: meet face to face (Balanced); face me in battle (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of the idiom; Readable says plainly that it is a challenge to battle (m1).

decisions.choice: the son of Jehoahaz and grandson of Jehu
decisions.reason: Readable puts the title first and explains the chain of names.

decisions.choice: "enfrentémonos cara a cara" (B); "Sal a enfrentarte conmigo en batalla" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the face of the idiom and adds that it is a confrontation; Readable says plainly that it is a challenge to battle (m1).

decisions.choice: "mesurons-nous face à face" (B); "Viens m'affronter au combat" (R)
decisions.reason: The idiom is a challenge to battle (m1); "se mesurer" keeps the face-to-face picture while saying it is a contest, and Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: Njoo tupigane vita
decisions.reason: Readable says what the challenge meant, a call to battle (meaning decision m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: đối mặt nhau (B); ra đây giao chiến với ta (R)
decisions.reason: "Gặp mặt" would sound like a friendly visit; Balanced says "đối mặt", which carries the challenge, and Readable says plainly that it is a call to battle.

decisions.choice: "예후의 손자 여호아하스의 아들 이스라엘 왕 여호아스"
decisions.reason: Korean puts the line of descent before the name; "son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu" in Korean order needs "예후의 손자" to stay clear.

decisions.choice: The two kings speak to each other in the plain style (해라체)
decisions.reason: A challenge between equals and rivals; the plain style carries the defiance, and Jehoash's mocking answer in verses 9-10 keeps it.

decisions.choice: você (king to king, verses 8-10)
decisions.reason: The two kings speak to each other as equals, with "você", as Asa and Ben-hadad do in 1 Kings 15:19 in Portuguese; Jehoash's scorn in verse 10 is carried by what he says, not by the form of address.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הַח֜וֹחַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּלְּבָנ֗וֹן שָׁ֠לַח אֶל־הָאֶ֜רֶז אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּלְּבָנוֹן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תְּנָֽה־אֶת־בִּתְּךָ֥ לִבְנִ֖י לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַֽתַּעֲבֹ֞ר חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּלְּבָנ֔וֹן וַתִּרְמֹ֖ס אֶת־הַחֽוֹחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Jehoash king of Israel to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle which [was] in Lebanon sent to the cedar which [was] in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son for a wife; and passed by [the] beast of the field which [was] in Lebanon and trampled the thistle.

en.L: And Jehoash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, "The thistle that [was] in Lebanon sent to the cedar that [was] in Lebanon, saying, 'Give your daughter to my son as a wife.' And a wild animal of the field that [was] in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thistle.
en.B: Jehoash king of Israel sent back word to Amaziah king of Judah: "There was a thistle in Lebanon that sent word to a cedar in Lebanon: 'Give your daughter to my son as his wife.' Then a wild animal in Lebanon came by and trampled the thistle.
en.R: Jehoash king of Israel sent this answer to Amaziah king of Judah: "Once a thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar tree in Lebanon. It said, 'Let your daughter marry my son.' But then a wild animal in Lebanon walked by and crushed the thistle under its feet.

es.L: Y Joás, rey de Israel, envió a decir a Amasías, rey de Judá: «El cardo que [estaba] en el Líbano envió a decir al cedro que [estaba] en el Líbano: “Da tu hija a mi hijo por mujer”. Y pasó una fiera del campo que [estaba] en el Líbano y pisoteó el cardo.
es.B: Joás, rey de Israel, le respondió a Amasías, rey de Judá: «Había un cardo en el Líbano que le mandó decir a un cedro del Líbano: “Dale tu hija a mi hijo por esposa”. Pero pasó por allí una fiera del Líbano y pisoteó el cardo.
es.R: Joás, rey de Israel, le envió esta respuesta a Amasías, rey de Judá: «Una vez, un cardo del Líbano le envió un mensaje a un cedro del Líbano. Le dijo: “Deja que tu hija se case con mi hijo”. Pero entonces pasó un animal salvaje del Líbano y aplastó el cardo con las patas.

fr.L: Et Yehoash, roi d’Israël, envoya [dire] à Amatsia, roi de Juda : « Le chardon qui [était] au Liban envoya [dire] au cèdre qui [était] au Liban : “Donne ta fille à mon fils pour femme.” Et une bête des champs qui [était] au Liban passa et piétina le chardon.
fr.B: Yehoash, roi d’Israël, fit répondre à Amatsia, roi de Juda : « Il y avait au Liban un chardon qui envoya dire à un cèdre du Liban : “Donne ta fille pour femme à mon fils.” Mais une bête sauvage du Liban passa et piétina le chardon.
fr.R: Yehoash, roi d’Israël, a envoyé cette réponse à Amatsia, roi de Juda : « Un jour, au Liban, un chardon a envoyé un message à un cèdre du Liban. Il lui a dit : “Laisse ta fille épouser mon fils.” Mais une bête sauvage du Liban est passée par là et a écrasé le chardon sous ses pattes.

sw.L: Naye Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli akatuma kwa Amazia mfalme wa Yuda, akisema, "Mbigili uliokuwa katika Lebanoni ulituma kwa mwerezi uliokuwa katika Lebanoni, ukisema, 'Mpe mwanangu binti yako awe mke wake.' Na mnyama wa mwituni aliyekuwa katika Lebanoni akapita, akaukanyaga mbigili.
sw.B: Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli akamjibu Amazia mfalme wa Yuda: "Mbigili mmoja huko Lebanoni ulituma ujumbe kwa mwerezi huko Lebanoni: 'Mpe mwanangu binti yako awe mke wake.' Kisha mnyama wa mwituni wa Lebanoni akapita, akaukanyaga mbigili huo.
sw.R: Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli alimtumia Amazia mfalme wa Yuda jibu hili: "Siku moja mbigili huko Lebanoni ulituma ujumbe kwa mti wa mwerezi huko Lebanoni. Ulisema, 'Mwache binti yako aolewe na mwanangu.' Lakini mnyama wa mwituni wa Lebanoni akapita, akaupondaponda mbigili huo chini ya miguu yake.

vi.L: Giê-hô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên sai [người] đến A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa, nói: "Cây gai ở Li-ban sai [người] đến cây bá hương ở Li-ban, nói: 'Hãy gả con gái ngươi cho con trai ta làm vợ.' Nhưng một con thú hoang ở Li-ban đi ngang qua và giày đạp cây gai.
vi.B: Giê-hô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên sai người trả lời A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa: "Có một cây gai ở Li-ban sai người đến nói với một cây bá hương ở Li-ban: 'Hãy gả con gái ngươi cho con trai ta làm vợ.' Rồi một con thú hoang ở Li-ban đi ngang qua và giày đạp cây gai ấy.
vi.R: Giê-hô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên trả lời A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa như sau: "Ngày xưa, một cây gai ở Li-ban gửi lời đến một cây bá hương ở Li-ban: 'Hãy gả con gái ngươi cho con trai ta.' Nhưng rồi một con thú hoang ở Li-ban đi ngang qua và giẫm nát cây gai.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕 여호아스가 유다 왕 아마샤에게 [사람을] 보내어 말했다. "레바논에 [있던] 가시나무가 레바논에 [있던] 백향목에게 [사람을] 보내어 말했다. '네 딸을 내 아들에게 아내로 주어라.' 그런데 레바논에 [있던] 들짐승이 지나가다가 그 가시나무를 짓밟았다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕 여호아스가 유다 왕 아마샤에게 회답을 보냈다. "레바논의 가시나무가 레바논의 백향목에게 '네 딸을 내 아들의 아내로 다오' 하고 전갈을 보냈다. 그런데 레바논의 들짐승이 지나가다가 그 가시나무를 짓밟아 버렸다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕 여호아스가 유다 왕 아마샤에게 이런 대답을 보냈다. "옛날에 레바논의 가시나무가 레바논의 백향목에게 말을 전했다. '네 딸을 내 아들과 결혼시켜라.' 그런데 레바논의 들짐승이 지나가다가 그 가시나무를 발로 짓밟아 버렸다.

pt.L: E Jeoás, rei de Israel, mandou [dizer] a Amazias, rei de Judá: "O cardo que [estava] no Líbano mandou [dizer] ao cedro que [estava] no Líbano: 'Dê a sua filha ao meu filho por mulher.' E passou um animal do campo que [estava] no Líbano e pisoteou o cardo.
pt.B: Jeoás, rei de Israel, mandou esta resposta a Amazias, rei de Judá: "Havia no Líbano um cardo que mandou dizer a um cedro do Líbano: 'Dê a sua filha como esposa ao meu filho.' Mas um animal selvagem do Líbano passou por ali e pisoteou o cardo.
pt.R: Jeoás, rei de Israel, mandou esta resposta a Amazias, rei de Judá: "Certa vez um cardo do Líbano mandou uma mensagem a um cedro do Líbano. Ele disse: 'Deixe a sua filha se casar com o meu filho.' Mas então um animal selvagem do Líbano passou por ali e esmagou o cardo com as patas.

decisions.choice: a fable: the thistle and the cedar
decisions.reason: Jehoash answers with a short fable, as Jotham did with the trees (Judges 9:8-15). The thistle is Amaziah, small and weak but asking to be treated as an equal by the great cedar, Israel. A marriage between their children would make them equals. The wild animal passes by and crushes the thistle without effort: Amaziah, if he fights, will be crushed just as easily. Verse 10 spells out the lesson.

decisions.choice: thistle: a low, prickly weed
decisions.reason: The word names a thorny plant, a thornbush or thistle. In the fable it stands for something small and worthless next to the tall cedar.

decisions.choice: the cedar in Lebanon: a picture of greatness
decisions.reason: The cedars of the Lebanon mountains were the tallest and finest trees the Israelites knew (1 Kings 5:20; Psalm 92:13).

decisions.choice: beast of the field: a wild animal
decisions.reason: "Beast of the field" means an animal that lives in the open country, not a farm animal.

decisions.choice: thistle
decisions.reason: Every level says "thistle", a weed every reader knows, so the contrast with the cedar is clear.

decisions.choice: Once
decisions.reason: Readable begins with "Once" so the reader hears at once that this is a story, not news.

decisions.choice: "cardo"
decisions.reason: Every level says "cardo", a weed every reader knows, so the contrast with the cedar is plain, as the English does with "thistle".

decisions.choice: "chardon"
decisions.reason: A low prickly weed set against the tall cedar (m2); "chardon" is the common French word for it.

decisions.choice: mbigili
decisions.reason: "Mbigili" is the low prickly weed of the fable, set against the tall cedar; the plant speaks with the "u-" agreement of its class, as a fable allows.

decisions.choice: cây gai; cây bá hương
decisions.reason: "Cây gai", a weed every reader knows, keeps the contrast with the great cedar, "cây bá hương"; Readable opens with "Ngày xưa" so the reader hears a fable.

decisions.choice: "가시나무" for the thistle
decisions.reason: The fable sets a lowly prickly plant against the great cedar; "가시나무" is the plainer word and pairs naturally with "백향목".

decisions.choice: o cardo; o cedro
decisions.reason: The low prickly weed (m2) is "cardo" at every level, a plant every Portuguese reader knows, which sets it at once against the tall "cedro" (m3). "Espinheiro" is kept for the different plant of Jotham's fable (Judges 9:14), so the two fables are not made to sound alike in a way the Hebrew does not.

source.text: הַכֵּ֤ה הִכִּ֨יתָ֙ אֶת־אֱד֔וֹם וּֽנְשָׂאֲךָ֖ לִבֶּ֑ךָ הִכָּבֵד֙ וְשֵׁ֣ב בְּבֵיתֶ֔ךָ וְלָ֤מָּה תִתְגָּרֶה֙ בְּרָעָ֔ה וְנָ֣פַלְתָּ֔ה אַתָּ֖ה וִיהוּדָ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely you have struck down Edom, and has lifted you your heart; be honored and stay in your house; and why should you stir up strife with evil, and you will fall, you and Judah with you?

en.L: Indeed you have struck down Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Have your glory, and stay in your house. And why should you stir up trouble to your harm, so that you fall, you and Judah with you?"
en.B: You have certainly defeated Edom, and now your heart has made you proud. Enjoy your glory, but stay at home. Why stir up trouble that will only bring you down, you and Judah with you?"
en.R: You have beaten Edom, and now you think you are great. Be proud of your victory if you like, but stay at home. Why ask for trouble? You will fall, and Judah will fall with you."

es.L: Ciertamente has herido a Edom, y tu corazón te ha enaltecido. Gloríate y quédate en tu casa. ¿Y por qué provocas el mal, para que caigas tú, y Judá contigo?».
es.B: Es verdad que has derrotado a Edom, y ahora tu corazón te ha vuelto orgulloso. Disfruta de tu gloria, pero quédate en casa. ¿Por qué buscas una pelea que solo te traerá la ruina a ti y a Judá contigo?».
es.R: Has vencido a Edom, y ahora te crees muy grande. Siéntete orgulloso de tu victoria si quieres, pero quédate en casa. ¿Para qué buscas problemas? Caerás tú, y Judá caerá contigo».

fr.L: Certes tu as frappé Édom, et ton cœur t’a élevé. Jouis de ta gloire, et reste dans ta maison. Pourquoi provoquerais-tu le malheur, pour tomber, toi et Juda avec toi ? »
fr.B: Tu as battu Édom, c’est vrai, et ton cœur s’en est enorgueilli. Savoure ta gloire, mais reste chez toi. Pourquoi provoquer un malheur qui te ferait tomber, toi et Juda avec toi ? »
fr.R: Tu as vaincu les Édomites, et maintenant tu te crois grand. Sois fier de ta victoire si tu veux, mais reste chez toi. Pourquoi chercher les ennuis ? Tu vas tomber, et Juda tombera avec toi. »

sw.L: Hakika umewapiga Edomu, na moyo wako umekuinua. Furahia utukufu wako, ukae nyumbani mwako. Na kwa nini ujichokozee mabaya, hata uanguke, wewe na Yuda pamoja nawe?"
sw.B: Kweli umewashinda Waedomu, na sasa moyo wako umekufanya ujivune. Furahia utukufu wako, lakini kaa nyumbani. Kwa nini kuchochea taabu itakayokuangusha tu, wewe na Yuda pamoja nawe?"
sw.R: Umewashinda Waedomu, na sasa unajiona kuwa mkuu. Jivunie ushindi wako ukitaka, lakini kaa nyumbani. Kwa nini unajitafutia taabu? Utaanguka, na Yuda wataanguka pamoja nawe."

vi.L: Quả thật ngươi đã đánh Ê-đôm, và lòng ngươi đã nâng ngươi lên. Hãy hưởng vinh quang và ở nhà ngươi. Sao ngươi lại khiêu khích tai họa để ngươi ngã, ngươi và Giu-đa cùng với ngươi?"
vi.B: Ngươi quả đã đánh bại Ê-đôm, và giờ lòng ngươi kiêu ngạo. Hãy hưởng vinh quang của ngươi, nhưng hãy ở nhà. Sao lại gây chuyện để chuốc lấy tai họa, khiến ngươi và cả Giu-đa cùng ngã?"
vi.R: Ngươi đã thắng Ê-đôm, và giờ ngươi tưởng mình vĩ đại. Muốn tự hào về chiến thắng thì cứ tự hào, nhưng hãy ở nhà. Sao lại đi tìm rắc rối? Ngươi sẽ ngã, và Giu-đa sẽ ngã cùng với ngươi."

ko.L: 네가 참으로 에돔을 쳤더니 네 마음이 너를 높였구나. 영광을 누리고 네 집에 머물러라. 어찌하여 네가 화를 불러 재앙을 일으켜, 너와 너와 함께 유다가 넘어지려 하느냐?"
ko.B: 네가 에돔을 쳐서 이기더니 마음이 교만해졌구나. 그 영광을 누리며 집에나 머물러 있어라. 어찌하여 화를 자초하여 너와 유다가 함께 망하려 하느냐?"
ko.R: 네가 에돔을 이기더니 스스로 대단하다고 생각하는구나. 원한다면 네 승리를 자랑해도 좋다. 그러나 집에 가만히 있어라. 왜 괜히 말썽을 일으키려 하느냐? 그러다가는 너도 망하고 유다도 너와 함께 망할 것이다."

pt.L: Você de fato feriu Edom, e o seu coração o elevou. Fique com a sua glória e permaneça na sua casa. E por que você provocaria o mal e cairia, você e Judá com você?"
pt.B: Você de fato derrotou Edom, e agora o seu coração o deixou orgulhoso. Aproveite a sua glória, mas fique em casa. Por que provocar uma desgraça que só vai derrubar você e Judá junto com você?"
pt.R: Você venceu Edom, e agora pensa que é grande. Fique orgulhoso da sua vitória, se quiser, mas fique em casa. Por que arranjar problemas? Você vai cair, e Judá vai cair junto com você."

decisions.choice: your heart has lifted you up: you have become proud
decisions.reason: The heart lifting someone up is a picture of pride (Deuteronomy 8:14; 17:20). Jehoash sees that the victory over Edom has gone to Amaziah's head.

decisions.choice: be honored: be content with the honor you have
decisions.reason: The verb is a command: take your glory, enjoy it. It is said with some scorn. Jehoash lets Amaziah have the credit for Edom but tells him to go no further.

decisions.choice: stir up strife to your harm
decisions.reason: The verb means to provoke a fight. "With evil" means trouble that will turn into disaster for the one who starts it.

decisions.choice: and you will fall: the result of the fight
decisions.reason: The question names what will follow if Amaziah goes to war: his own fall, and Judah's with him.

decisions.choice: made you proud; Enjoy your glory (Balanced); think you are great; Be proud ... if you like (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idioms mean (m1, m2). Readable breaks the question into a question and a warning.

decisions.choice: "ton cœur s'en est enorgueilli", "Savoure ta gloire" (B); "tu te crois grand", "Sois fier ... si tu veux" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable say the sense of "your heart has lifted you up" (m1) and of the mocking "be honored" (m2).

decisions.choice: moyo wako umekufanya ujivune (Balanced); unajiona kuwa mkuu (Readable)
decisions.reason: "The heart lifted up" is pride (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable say so, as the English does.

decisions.choice: king to king: ngươi / ta
decisions.reason: Jehoash answers a challenge with scorn, so the king of Israel says "ngươi" to Amaziah, the form the kings use to subjects.

decisions.choice: "마음이 교만해졌구나" (B); "스스로 대단하다고 생각하는구나" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means; Literal keeps the heart lifting him up.

source.text: וְלֹא־שָׁמַ֣ע אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ וַיַּ֨עַל יְהוֹאָ֤שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיִּתְרָא֣וּ פָנִ֔ים ה֖וּא וַאֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה בְּבֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִיהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And not listened Amaziah; and went up Jehoash king of Israel, and they looked at one another [in the] face, he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh which [belongs] to Judah.

en.L: But Amaziah did not listen. And Jehoash king of Israel went up, and they looked one another in the face, he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which [belongs] to Judah.
en.B: Amaziah, however, would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up against him, and the two kings, he and Amaziah king of Judah, met face to face at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
en.R: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel marched out with his army, and the two kings met in battle at Beth-shemesh, a town in Judah.

es.L: Pero Amasías no escuchó. Y subió Joás, rey de Israel, y se miraron cara a cara él y Amasías, rey de Judá, en Bet-semes, que [es] de Judá.
es.B: Pero Amasías no quiso escuchar. Entonces Joás, rey de Israel, subió contra él, y los dos reyes, él y Amasías, rey de Judá, se enfrentaron cara a cara en Bet-semes, que pertenece a Judá.
es.R: Pero Amasías no quiso escuchar. Entonces Joás, rey de Israel, salió con su ejército, y los dos reyes se enfrentaron en batalla en Bet-semes, una ciudad de Judá.

fr.L: Mais Amatsia n’écouta pas. Et Yehoash, roi d’Israël, monta, et ils se regardèrent en face, lui et Amatsia, roi de Juda, à Beth-Shémesh, qui [est] à Juda.
fr.B: Mais Amatsia ne voulut pas écouter. Alors Yehoash, roi d’Israël, monta contre lui, et les deux rois, lui et Amatsia, roi de Juda, s’affrontèrent à Beth-Shémesh, qui appartient à Juda.
fr.R: Mais Amatsia n’a pas voulu écouter. Alors Yehoash, roi d’Israël, est parti avec son armée, et les deux rois se sont affrontés au combat à Beth-Shémesh, une ville de Juda.

sw.L: Lakini Amazia hakusikiliza. Naye Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli akapanda, nao wakatazamana uso kwa uso, yeye na Amazia mfalme wa Yuda, huko Beth-shemeshi, ulio wa Yuda.
sw.B: Lakini Amazia hakutaka kusikiliza. Basi Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli akapanda dhidi yake, nao wafalme hao wawili, yeye na Amazia mfalme wa Yuda, wakakutana uso kwa uso huko Beth-shemeshi, ulio wa Yuda.
sw.R: Lakini Amazia hakutaka kusikiliza. Basi Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli akaenda na jeshi lake, nao wafalme hao wawili wakapigana vita huko Beth-shemeshi, mji wa Yuda.

vi.L: Nhưng A-ma-xia không nghe. Giê-hô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đi lên, và họ nhìn mặt nhau, ông và A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa, tại Bết-Sê-mết, [thành] thuộc Giu-đa.
vi.B: Nhưng A-ma-xia không chịu nghe. Vậy Giê-hô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên kéo quân lên, và hai vua, ông và A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa, đối mặt nhau tại Bết-Sê-mết, thuộc Giu-đa.
vi.R: Nhưng A-ma-xia không chịu nghe. Vậy Giê-hô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên kéo quân ra, và hai vua giao chiến tại Bết-Sê-mết, một thành của Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그러나 아마샤가 듣지 않았다. 그래서 이스라엘 왕 여호아스가 올라왔고, 그와 유다 왕 아마샤가 유다에 [속한] 벧세메스에서 서로 얼굴을 마주 보았다.
ko.B: 그러나 아마샤는 듣지 않았다. 그래서 이스라엘 왕 여호아스가 올라왔다. 그와 유다 왕 아마샤는 유다 땅 벧세메스에서 얼굴을 맞대고 맞섰다.
ko.R: 그러나 아마샤는 그 말을 듣지 않았다. 그래서 이스라엘 왕 여호아스가 군대를 이끌고 올라왔다. 두 왕은 유다의 성읍 벧세메스에서 맞붙어 싸웠다.

pt.L: Mas Amazias não ouviu. E Jeoás, rei de Israel, subiu, e eles se viram face a face, ele e Amazias, rei de Judá, em Bete-Semes, que [pertence] a Judá.
pt.B: Amazias, porém, não quis ouvir. Então Jeoás, rei de Israel, subiu contra ele, e os dois reis, ele e Amazias, rei de Judá, se encontraram face a face em Bete-Semes, que pertence a Judá.
pt.R: Mas Amazias não quis ouvir. Então Jeoás, rei de Israel, saiu com o seu exército, e os dois reis se enfrentaram numa batalha em Bete-Semes, uma cidade de Judá.

decisions.choice: looked one another in the face: met in battle
decisions.reason: The words of Amaziah's challenge (verse 8) come true: the two kings face each other in battle.

decisions.choice: Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Judah
decisions.reason: Beth-shemesh was a town of Judah in the low hills west of Jerusalem (Joshua 15:10; 1 Samuel 6:9-21). The note that it belonged to Judah shows that Jehoash did not wait to be attacked but carried the war into Judah's own land.

decisions.choice: went up: marched out to war
decisions.reason: "Went up" is used of an army setting out against an enemy.

decisions.choice: with his army; in battle
decisions.reason: Readable says that Jehoash came with an army and that the meeting was a battle (m1, m3).

decisions.choice: "Bet-semes"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form of Beth-shemesh, kept the same through these books.

source.text: וַיִּנָּ֥גֶף יְהוּדָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְאֹהָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And was struck Judah before Israel, and they fled, each to his tents.

en.L: And Judah was struck down before Israel, and they fled, each to his tents.
en.B: Judah was defeated by Israel, and every man fled to his home.
en.R: Israel defeated Judah, and all the soldiers of Judah ran away to their homes.

es.L: Y Judá fue herido delante de Israel, y huyeron cada uno a sus tiendas.
es.B: Judá fue derrotado por Israel, y cada uno huyó a su casa.
es.R: Israel derrotó a Judá, y todos los soldados de Judá huyeron a sus casas.

fr.L: Et Juda fut battu devant Israël, et ils s’enfuirent chacun à ses tentes.
fr.B: Juda fut battu par Israël, et chacun s’enfuit chez lui.
fr.R: Israël a battu Juda, et tous les soldats de Juda se sont enfuis chez eux.

sw.L: Naye Yuda akapigwa mbele ya Israeli, nao wakakimbia, kila mtu hemani kwake.
sw.B: Yuda walishindwa na Israeli, na kila mtu akakimbilia nyumbani kwake.
sw.R: Israeli waliwashinda Yuda, na askari wote wa Yuda wakakimbia, kila mmoja nyumbani kwake.

vi.L: Giu-đa bị đánh bại trước Y-sơ-ra-ên, và họ chạy trốn, mỗi người về trại mình.
vi.B: Giu-đa bị Y-sơ-ra-ên đánh bại, và ai nấy chạy trốn về nhà mình.
vi.R: Y-sơ-ra-ên đánh bại Giu-đa, và mọi binh sĩ Giu-đa đều bỏ chạy về nhà.

ko.L: 그리고 유다가 이스라엘 앞에서 패하여, 각자 자기 장막으로 도망쳤다.
ko.B: 유다는 이스라엘에게 패하여, 모두 자기 집으로 도망쳤다.
ko.R: 이스라엘이 유다를 쳐서 이겼다. 유다 군사들은 모두 자기 집으로 도망쳤다.

pt.L: E Judá foi ferido diante de Israel, e fugiram, cada um para as suas tendas.
pt.B: Judá foi derrotado por Israel, e cada homem fugiu para a sua casa.
pt.R: Israel derrotou Judá, e todos os soldados de Judá fugiram para casa.

decisions.choice: fled each to his tents: the army broke up and went home
decisions.reason: "To his tents" is an old way of saying "home" (1 Samuel 4:10; 2 Samuel 18:17; 1 Kings 12:16). Judah's army scattered.

decisions.choice: to his tents
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) and the form the scribes marked to be read aloud (qere) differ in the spelling of "his tent" or "his tents". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: every man fled to his home (Balanced); the soldiers ... ran away to their homes (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the plain sense of the idiom (m1). Readable makes Israel the subject of an active verb.

decisions.choice: "chacun s'enfuit chez lui" (B); "tous les soldats ... se sont enfuis chez eux" (R)
decisions.reason: "To his tents" means the army broke up and went home (m1); Literal keeps the tents.

source.text: וְאֵת֩ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֜ה בֶּן־יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ תָּפַ֛שׂ יְהוֹאָ֥שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּבֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וַיָּבֹא֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיִּפְרֹץ֩ בְּחוֹמַ֨ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם בְּשַׁ֤עַר אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ עַד־שַׁ֣עַר הַפִּנָּ֔ה אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Amaziah king of Judah son of Jehoash son of Ahaziah, seized Jehoash king of Israel at Beth-shemesh; and he came [to] Jerusalem and broke into [the] wall of Jerusalem at [the] gate of Ephraim to [the] gate of the corner, four hundred cubit[s].

en.L: And Amaziah king of Judah, son of Jehoash son of Ahaziah, Jehoash king of Israel seized at Beth-shemesh; and he came [to] Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem at the Gate of Ephraim up to the Corner Gate, 400 cubits.
en.B: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah prisoner at Beth-shemesh; Amaziah was the son of Jehoash son of Ahaziah. Then Jehoash came to Jerusalem and tore down the wall of Jerusalem along a stretch of {{units:about 600 feet|400 cubits}}, from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.
en.R: Jehoash king of Israel captured King Amaziah of Judah at Beth-shemesh. (Amaziah was the son of Jehoash and grandson of Ahaziah.) Then Jehoash went to Jerusalem and broke down {{units:about 600 feet|400 cubits}} of the city wall, from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.

es.L: Y a Amasías, rey de Judá, hijo de Joás hijo de Ocozías, lo apresó Joás, rey de Israel, en Bet-semes; y vino a Jerusalén y derribó el muro de Jerusalén desde la puerta de Efraín hasta la puerta del Ángulo, cuatrocientos codos.
es.B: Joás, rey de Israel, tomó prisionero en Bet-semes a Amasías, rey de Judá, hijo de Joás hijo de Ocozías. Luego Joás fue a Jerusalén y derribó el muro de Jerusalén en un tramo de {{units:unos 180 metros|400 codos}}, desde la puerta de Efraín hasta la puerta del Ángulo.
es.R: Joás, rey de Israel, capturó en Bet-semes al rey Amasías de Judá. (Amasías era hijo de Joás y nieto de Ocozías). Después Joás fue a Jerusalén y derribó {{units:unos 180 metros|400 codos}} del muro de la ciudad, desde la puerta de Efraín hasta la puerta del Ángulo.

fr.L: Et Amatsia, roi de Juda, fils de Yehoash fils d’Achazia, Yehoash, roi d’Israël, le saisit à Beth-Shémesh ; et il vint [à] Jérusalem et fit une brèche dans la muraille de Jérusalem, depuis la porte d’Éphraïm jusqu’à la porte de l’Angle, quatre cents coudées.
fr.B: Yehoash, roi d’Israël, fit prisonnier à Beth-Shémesh Amatsia, roi de Juda, fils de Yehoash, fils d’Achazia. Puis Yehoash vint à Jérusalem et abattit la muraille de Jérusalem sur {{units:environ 180 mètres|quatre cents coudées}}, depuis la porte d’Éphraïm jusqu’à la porte de l’Angle.
fr.R: Yehoash, roi d’Israël, a capturé Amatsia, roi de Juda, à Beth-Shémesh. (Amatsia était le fils de Yehoash et le petit-fils d’Achazia.) Ensuite, Yehoash est allé à Jérusalem et il a démoli {{units:environ 180 mètres|quatre cents coudées}} de la muraille de la ville, depuis la porte d’Éphraïm jusqu’à la porte de l’Angle.

sw.L: Naye Amazia mfalme wa Yuda, mwana wa Yehoashi mwana wa Ahazia, Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli alimkamata huko Beth-shemeshi; naye akaja [hata] Yerusalemu, akabomoa ukuta wa Yerusalemu kutoka Lango la Efraimu mpaka Lango la Pembeni, dhiraa 400.
sw.B: Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli alimkamata Amazia mfalme wa Yuda huko Beth-shemeshi; Amazia alikuwa mwana wa Yehoashi mwana wa Ahazia. Kisha Yehoashi akaja Yerusalemu, akabomoa ukuta wa Yerusalemu kwa urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 180|dhiraa 400}}, kutoka Lango la Efraimu mpaka Lango la Pembeni.
sw.R: Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli alimkamata mfalme Amazia wa Yuda huko Beth-shemeshi. (Amazia alikuwa mwana wa Yehoashi na mjukuu wa Ahazia.) Kisha Yehoashi akaenda Yerusalemu, akabomoa ukuta wa mji kwa urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 180|dhiraa 400}}, kutoka Lango la Efraimu mpaka Lango la Pembeni.

vi.L: A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa, con trai Giê-hô-ách, con trai A-cha-xia, thì Giê-hô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên bắt tại Bết-Sê-mết; rồi ông đến Giê-ru-sa-lem và phá tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem từ Cổng Ép-ra-im đến Cổng Góc, bốn trăm cu-đê.
vi.B: Giê-hô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên bắt A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa tại Bết-Sê-mết; A-ma-xia là con trai Giê-hô-ách, cháu A-cha-xia. Rồi Giê-hô-ách đến Giê-ru-sa-lem và phá một đoạn tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem dài {{units:khoảng 180 m|bốn trăm cu-đê}}, từ Cổng Ép-ra-im đến Cổng Góc.
vi.R: Giê-hô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên bắt được vua A-ma-xia của Giu-đa tại Bết-Sê-mết. (A-ma-xia là con trai Giê-hô-ách và cháu nội A-cha-xia.) Rồi Giê-hô-ách đến Giê-ru-sa-lem và phá đổ {{units:khoảng 180 m|bốn trăm cu-đê}} tường thành, từ Cổng Ép-ra-im đến Cổng Góc.

ko.L: 그리고 아하시야의 손자 여호아스의 아들 유다 왕 아마샤를 이스라엘 왕 여호아스가 벧세메스에서 사로잡았다. 그리고 그가 예루살렘에 와서 에브라임 문에서 모퉁이 문까지 예루살렘 성벽을 사백 규빗 허물었다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕 여호아스는 벧세메스에서 유다 왕 아마샤를 사로잡았다. 아마샤는 아하시야의 손자요 여호아스의 아들이었다. 그 뒤에 여호아스는 예루살렘으로 가서, 에브라임 문에서 모퉁이 문까지 {{units:약 180미터|400규빗}}에 걸쳐 예루살렘 성벽을 헐어 버렸다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕 여호아스는 벧세메스에서 유다 왕 아마샤를 사로잡았다. (아마샤는 여호아스의 아들이고 아하시야의 손자였다.) 그 뒤에 여호아스는 예루살렘으로 가서 에브라임 문에서 모퉁이 문까지 성벽을 {{units:약 180미터|400규빗}} 무너뜨렸다.

pt.L: E Amazias, rei de Judá, filho de Joás, filho de Acazias, Jeoás, rei de Israel, o prendeu em Bete-Semes; e veio [a] Jerusalém e derrubou o muro de Jerusalém, desde a Porta de Efraim até a Porta da Esquina, quatrocentos côvados.
pt.B: Jeoás, rei de Israel, prendeu Amazias, rei de Judá, em Bete-Semes; Amazias era filho de Joás, filho de Acazias. Depois Jeoás foi a Jerusalém e derrubou o muro de Jerusalém num trecho de {{units:cerca de 180 metros|quatrocentos côvados}}, desde a Porta de Efraim até a Porta da Esquina.
pt.R: Jeoás, rei de Israel, capturou o rei Amazias, de Judá, em Bete-Semes. (Amazias era filho de Joás e neto de Acazias.) Depois Jeoás foi a Jerusalém e derrubou {{units:cerca de 180 metros|quatrocentos côvados}} do muro da cidade, desde a Porta de Efraim até a Porta da Esquina.

decisions.choice: son of Jehoash: Amaziah's father Joash, by the full form of his name
decisions.reason: Here Amaziah's father, called Joash in verses 1, 3 and 17, is named with the full form Jehoash, the same name the king of Israel bears (verse 1). The sentence puts the name of the captured king first, for emphasis.

decisions.choice: and he came to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) and the form the scribes marked to be read aloud (qere) differ in this verb. The form read aloud, followed here, says "he came". 2 Chronicles 25:23 says that Jehoash brought Amaziah to Jerusalem, so the captured king was taken along.

decisions.choice: from the Gate of Ephraim to the Corner Gate: the north side of the wall
decisions.reason: The Gate of Ephraim faced north, toward the road to Ephraim; the Corner Gate stood at the northwest corner of the city (Jeremiah 31:38; Zechariah 14:10). The north was the side most open to attack, and breaking down this stretch of wall left Jerusalem without defense.

decisions.choice: broke down: broke through, tore down
decisions.reason: The verb means to break through. Jehoash tore down a long stretch of the wall, not just a gap for his troops.

decisions.choice: about 600 feet / 400 cubits
decisions.reason: The units setting gives the length in feet by default and in cubits as the alternative. A cubit is about 18 inches. Literal keeps "400 cubits".

decisions.choice: Jehoash ... took Amaziah prisoner
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the subject first, as English does; Literal keeps the Hebrew order. Both set Amaziah's family line apart and name Jehoash again, so the two men named Jehoash are not confused.

decisions.choice: {{units:unos 180 metros|400 codos}}
decisions.reason: As the terms notes set: metric by default where the English converts, with the cubit at 45 cm and the original unit as the alternative; Literal keeps "cuatrocientos codos", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "la puerta de Efraín"; "la puerta del Ángulo"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish names of the two gates of Jerusalem's north wall (m3).

decisions.choice: "environ 180 mètres" / "quatre cents coudées"
decisions.reason: For this block, units are metric by default in French with the original unit as the alternative: the cubit at 45 cm, as the terms note sets, gives about 180 metres where the English converts to feet. Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: {{units:karibu mita 180|dhiraa 400}}
decisions.reason: Swahili gives the metric figure by default, the cubit at 45 cm, with the original cubits as the alternative; the English gives feet. Literal keeps "dhiraa 400".

decisions.choice: {{units:khoảng 180 m|bốn trăm cu-đê}}
