decisions.reason: Vietnamese gives metric by default and the original unit as the alternative, with the cubit at 45 cm, unlike the English US units; Literal keeps "bốn trăm cu-đê".

decisions.choice: units span "약 180미터" / "사백 규빗"
decisions.reason: Korean uses metric by default with the original unit as the alternative (cubit 45 cm), where the English converts to feet; Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 180 metros|quatrocentos côvados}}; Literal "quatrocentos côvados"
decisions.reason: The units setting gives metres by default, where the English gives feet, at the cubit of 45 cm the Old Testament terms use, and the cubits as the alternative; Literal keeps the cubits. Amaziah's father is "Joás" though the Hebrew uses the long form here (m1), as set at 12:1, so that he is not taken for the king of Israel who captured his son.

source.text: וְלָקַ֣ח אֶת־כָּל־הַזָּהָב־וְ֠הַכֶּסֶף וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־הַכֵּלִ֜ים הַנִּמְצְאִ֣ים בֵּית־יְהוָ֗ה וּבְאֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י הַתַּֽעֲרֻב֑וֹת וַיָּ֖שָׁב שֹׁמְרֽוֹנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he took all the gold and the silver and all the vessels found [in the] house of Yahweh and in [the] treasuries of [the] house of the king, and the sons of the pledges, and he returned [to] Samaria.

en.L: And he took all the gold and the silver and all the vessels that were found [in the] house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in the treasuries of the house of the king, and the sons of the pledges, and he returned [to] Samaria.
en.B: He carried off all the gold and silver, and every article that was found in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in the palace treasuries. He also took hostages, and then he returned to Samaria.
en.R: He took all the gold and silver and all the valuable objects he found in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in the treasure rooms of the royal palace. He also took some people as hostages. Then he went back to Samaria.

es.L: Y tomó todo el oro y la plata, y todos los utensilios que se hallaron [en la] casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en los tesoros de la casa del rey, y los hijos de las fianzas, y volvió [a] Samaria.
es.B: Se llevó todo el oro y la plata, y todos los objetos que se encontraban en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en los tesoros del palacio. También tomó rehenes, y luego regresó a Samaria.
es.R: Se llevó todo el oro y la plata, y todos los objetos de valor que encontró en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en las salas del tesoro del palacio real. También se llevó a algunas personas como rehenes. Después regresó a Samaria.

fr.L: Et il prit tout l’or et l’argent, et tous les objets qui se trouvaient [dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et dans les trésors de la maison du roi, et les fils des gages, et il retourna [à] Samarie.
fr.B: Il emporta tout l’or et l’argent, et tous les objets qui se trouvaient dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et dans les trésors du palais. Il prit aussi des otages, puis il retourna à Samarie.
fr.R: Il a pris tout l’or, tout l’argent et tous les objets de valeur qu’il a trouvés dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et dans les salles du trésor du palais royal. Il a aussi emmené des gens comme otages. Puis il est rentré à Samarie.

sw.L: Naye akachukua dhahabu yote na fedha, na vyombo vyote vilivyoonekana [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika hazina za nyumba ya mfalme, na wana wa rehani, akarudi [hata] Samaria.
sw.B: Akachukua dhahabu yote na fedha, na kila chombo kilichoonekana katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika hazina za ikulu. Akachukua pia mateka kama rehani, kisha akarudi Samaria.
sw.R: Alichukua dhahabu yote na fedha na vitu vyote vya thamani alivyovikuta katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika vyumba vya hazina vya jumba la mfalme. Pia aliwachukua watu kadhaa kama mateka. Kisha akarudi Samaria.

vi.L: Ông lấy hết vàng bạc và mọi khí cụ tìm thấy [trong] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong các kho báu của cung vua, cùng các con tin, rồi trở về Sa-ma-ri.
vi.B: Ông lấy hết vàng bạc và mọi vật dụng tìm thấy trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong kho báu hoàng cung. Ông cũng bắt người làm con tin, rồi trở về Sa-ma-ri.
vi.R: Ông lấy hết vàng bạc và mọi đồ vật quý tìm thấy trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong các phòng chứa báu vật của hoàng cung. Ông cũng bắt một số người làm con tin. Rồi ông trở về Sa-ma-ri.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 왕의 집 보물 창고들에서 발견된 모든 금과 은과 모든 기구와 볼모의 아들들을 잡아 사마리아로 돌아갔다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 왕궁 보물 창고에 있던 금과 은과 모든 기물을 다 가져갔다. 또 볼모들도 잡아 사마리아로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전과 왕궁 보물 창고에서 찾아낸 금과 은과 값진 물건들을 모두 가져갔다. 그는 또 사람들을 인질로 잡아갔다. 그리고 사마리아로 돌아갔다.

pt.L: E tomou todo o ouro e a prata, e todos os utensílios que se acharam [na] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e nos tesouros da casa do rei, e os filhos dos penhores, e voltou [para] Samaria.
pt.B: Ele levou todo o ouro e a prata e todos os objetos que se encontravam na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e nos tesouros do palácio. Levou também reféns, e depois voltou para Samaria.
pt.R: Ele levou todo o ouro e a prata e todos os objetos de valor que encontrou no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e nas salas do tesouro do palácio real. Também levou algumas pessoas como reféns. Depois voltou para Samaria.

decisions.choice: the sons of the pledges: hostages
decisions.reason: The phrase appears only here and in 2 Chronicles 25:24. "Sons of" names people who belong to a group; these were people given as pledges, held in Samaria to make sure Judah kept the peace.

decisions.choice: the house of Yahweh; the house of the king: the temple and the palace
decisions.reason: "House" is used of Yahweh's temple and of the king's palace. Their treasuries had already been emptied once to buy off Hazael king of Aram (12:19).

decisions.choice: vessels: valuable objects of every kind
decisions.reason: The word covers containers, tools and other articles, here the costly items kept in the temple and palace.

decisions.choice: articles; the palace treasuries (Balanced); valuable objects; the temple; the royal palace (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the buildings as readers know them. Readable says "temple" for "the house of the LORD".

decisions.choice: "la casa del SEÑOR" (L, B); "el templo del SEÑOR" (R); "palacio" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets: "la casa del SEÑOR" at Literal and Balanced and "el templo del SEÑOR" at Readable; Balanced and Readable name the king's house as the palace.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de las fianzas" (L); "rehenes" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the rare Hebrew phrase; Balanced and Readable give its sense, hostages (m1).

decisions.choice: "la maison du SEIGNEUR" (L, B); "le temple du SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: For this block, as the terms note sets: the house of the LORD is "la maison du SEIGNEUR" at Literal and Balanced and "le temple du SEIGNEUR" at Readable.

decisions.choice: nyumba ya BWANA (Literal, Balanced); hekalu la BWANA (Readable); nyumba ya mfalme / ikulu / jumba la mfalme
alternatives: hekalu la BWANA at every level
decisions.reason: The house of the LORD in the terms note's wording; the king's house is the palace at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: wana wa rehani
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase "sons of the pledges"; Balanced and Readable say hostages.

decisions.choice: nhà của CHÚA (L, B); đền thờ của CHÚA (R); con tin
alternatives: con cái của sự cầm cố (L)
decisions.reason: "The house of the LORD" keeps the terms note wording, "đền thờ" at Readable. "The sons of the pledges" is given by its sense, "con tin", at every level: a word-for-word Literal would not be understood.

decisions.choice: "주의 집" (L, B); "주의 성전" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the house of the LORD, kept through Kings.

source.text: וְיֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהוֹאָ֜שׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ וּגְב֣וּרָת֔וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר נִלְחַ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and which he waged war with Amaziah king of Judah, [are] not they written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of the kings of Israel?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Jehoash that he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Jehoash, what he did, his might and how he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
en.R: Everything else Jehoash did is written in the history of the kings of Israel. It tells about his great deeds and how he fought against Amaziah king of Judah.

es.L: Y los demás hechos que hizo Joás, y su poderío, y cómo peleó contra Amasías, rey de Judá, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Joás, lo que hizo, su poderío y cómo peleó contra Amasías, rey de Judá, están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Joás está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Israel. Allí se cuentan sus hazañas y cómo peleó contra Amasías, rey de Judá.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Yehoash, ce qu’il fit, et sa vaillance, et comment il combattit contre Amatsia, roi de Juda, n’est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Yehoash, ce qu’il fit, sa vaillance et la manière dont il combattit contre Amatsia, roi de Juda, est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout le reste de ce qu’a fait Yehoash a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël. On y raconte ses exploits et sa guerre contre Amatsia, roi de Juda.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Yehoashi aliyoyafanya, na nguvu zake, na jinsi alivyopigana na Amazia mfalme wa Yuda, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Yehoashi, aliyoyafanya, nguvu zake na jinsi alivyopigana dhidi ya Amazia mfalme wa Yuda, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyoyafanya Yehoashi yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Israeli. Huko kuna habari za matendo yake makuu na jinsi alivyopigana dhidi ya Amazia mfalme wa Yuda.

vi.L: Các việc khác của Giê-hô-ách mà ông đã làm, sức mạnh của ông, và việc ông giao chiến với A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của Giê-hô-ách, những điều ông đã làm, sức mạnh của ông và việc ông giao chiến với A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa, đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Giê-hô-ách đã làm đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Sách ấy kể về những chiến công của ông và việc ông đánh A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 여호아스가 한 나머지 일들과 그의 용맹과 그가 유다 왕 아마샤와 싸운 것은 이스라엘 왕들의 날들의 일을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 여호아스의 나머지 행적, 곧 그가 한 일과 그의 용맹과 그가 유다 왕 아마샤와 맞서 싸운 일은 이스라엘 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 여호아스가 한 나머지 일은 이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다. 그 책에는 그의 용감한 업적과 그가 유다 왕 아마샤와 싸운 이야기가 실려 있다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Jeoás que ele fez, e o seu poder, e como lutou contra Amazias, rei de Judá, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
pt.B: Os demais atos de Jeoás, o que ele fez, o seu poder e como lutou contra Amazias, rei de Judá, estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Jeoás fez está escrito na história dos reis de Israel. Ali se conta sobre os seus grandes feitos e sobre como ele lutou contra Amazias, rei de Judá.

decisions.choice: verses 15-16 repeat 13:12-13
decisions.reason: The closing notice of Jehoash's reign was already given at 13:12-13 in almost the same words. It is given again here, after the account of his war with Amaziah, so that the story of Judah can go on.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel: a royal record now lost
decisions.reason: As throughout Kings, the writer sends the reader to a fuller written record of Israel's kings. The question "are they not written ...?" means "they are written".

decisions.choice: a statement in place of the question
decisions.reason: As in the sources formula throughout these books, Balanced and Readable state as a fact what the Hebrew asks as a question; Literal keeps the question.

decisions.choice: "el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel" (L); "el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel" (B); "la historia de los reyes de Israel" (R)
alternatives: el libro de las Crónicas de los reyes de Israel
decisions.reason: The source formula keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets it, and avoids "Crónicas", the Spanish title of the book of Chronicles; Balanced and Readable state it as a fact.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהוֹאָשׁ֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵר֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן עִ֖ם מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יָרָבְעָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Jehoash with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with [the] kings of Israel, and reigned Jeroboam his son in his place.

en.L: And Jehoash lay down with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel, and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Then Jehoash rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. His son Jeroboam became king in his place.
en.R: Then Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. His son Jeroboam became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Joás con sus padres, y fue sepultado en Samaria con los reyes de Israel; y reinó en su lugar Jeroboam su hijo.
es.B: Joás descansó con sus antepasados y fue sepultado en Samaria con los reyes de Israel. Su hijo Jeroboam reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Joás murió y fue sepultado en Samaria con los reyes de Israel. Su hijo Jeroboam lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Yehoash se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré à Samarie avec les rois d’Israël ; et Jéroboam son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Puis Yehoash reposa avec ses ancêtres, et il fut enterré à Samarie avec les rois d’Israël. Son fils Jéroboam régna à sa place.
fr.R: Puis Yehoash est mort et il a été enterré à Samarie avec les rois d’Israël. Son fils Jéroboam est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Naye Yehoashi akalala pamoja na baba zake, akazikwa huko Samaria pamoja na wafalme wa Israeli; na Yeroboamu mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Kisha Yehoashi alipumzika pamoja na babu zake, akazikwa huko Samaria pamoja na wafalme wa Israeli. Na mwanawe Yeroboamu akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Kisha Yehoashi alikufa, akazikwa huko Samaria pamoja na wafalme wa Israeli. Na mwanawe Yeroboamu akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Giê-hô-ách nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình và được chôn tại Sa-ma-ri với các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên; Giê-rô-bô-am con trai ông trị vì thay ông.
vi.B: Rồi Giê-hô-ách an giấc cùng tổ tiên và được chôn tại Sa-ma-ri với các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Giê-rô-bô-am con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Rồi Giê-hô-ách qua đời và được chôn tại Sa-ma-ri với các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Giê-rô-bô-am con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 여호아스가 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 사마리아에 이스라엘 왕들과 함께 묻혔다. 그리고 그의 아들 여로보암이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 여호아스는 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 사마리아에 이스라엘 왕들과 함께 묻혔다. 그의 아들 여로보암이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 여호아스는 죽었고, 사마리아에 이스라엘 왕들과 함께 묻혔다. 그의 아들 여로보암이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Jeoás descansou com os seus pais e foi sepultado em Samaria com os reis de Israel, e Jeroboão, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Então Jeoás descansou com os seus antepassados e foi sepultado em Samaria com os reis de Israel. E o seu filho Jeroboão reinou em seu lugar.
pt.R: Então Jeoás morreu e foi sepultado em Samaria com os reis de Israel. O seu filho Jeroboão se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The death formula of Kings, as at 13:13.

decisions.choice: Jeroboam his son: the second king named Jeroboam
decisions.reason: This Jeroboam is not Jeroboam son of Nebat, the first king of Israel (1 Kings 12:20). His own reign is told in verses 23-29.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula is worded the same way at each level throughout Kings.

decisions.choice: "durmió con sus padres" (L); "descansó con sus antepasados" (B); "murió" (R); the successor formula
decisions.reason: The death and successor formulas keep one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets them.

source.text: וַיְחִ֨י אֲמַצְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה אַֽחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת יְהוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן־יְהֽוֹאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And lived Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah after [the] death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen year[s].

en.L: And Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
en.B: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
en.R: Amaziah son of Joash, king of Judah, lived for fifteen more years after Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, died.

es.L: Y vivió Amasías hijo de Joás, rey de Judá, después de la muerte de Joás hijo de Joacaz, rey de Israel, quince años.
es.B: Amasías hijo de Joás, rey de Judá, vivió quince años después de la muerte de Joás hijo de Joacaz, rey de Israel.
es.R: Amasías hijo de Joás, rey de Judá, vivió quince años más después de que murió Joás hijo de Joacaz, rey de Israel.

fr.L: Et Amatsia fils de Joas, roi de Juda, vécut après la mort de Yehoash fils de Joachaz, roi d’Israël, quinze ans.
fr.B: Amatsia, fils de Joas, roi de Juda, vécut encore quinze ans après la mort de Yehoash, fils de Joachaz, roi d’Israël.
fr.R: Amatsia fils de Joas, roi de Juda, a vécu encore quinze ans après la mort de Yehoash fils de Joachaz, roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Naye Amazia mwana wa Yoashi mfalme wa Yuda akaishi baada ya kifo cha Yehoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi mfalme wa Israeli miaka kumi na mitano.
sw.B: Amazia mwana wa Yoashi mfalme wa Yuda aliishi miaka kumi na mitano baada ya kifo cha Yehoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi mfalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Amazia mwana wa Yoashi, mfalme wa Yuda, aliishi miaka kumi na mitano zaidi baada ya kufa kwa Yehoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi, mfalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: A-ma-xia con trai Giô-ách vua Giu-đa sống sau cái chết của Giê-hô-ách con trai Giô-a-cha vua Y-sơ-ra-ên mười lăm năm.
vi.B: A-ma-xia con trai Giô-ách vua Giu-đa sống thêm mười lăm năm sau khi Giê-hô-ách con trai Giô-a-cha vua Y-sơ-ra-ên qua đời.
vi.R: A-ma-xia con trai Giô-ách, vua Giu-đa, sống thêm mười lăm năm nữa sau khi Giê-hô-ách con trai Giô-a-cha, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, qua đời.

ko.L: 그리고 요아스의 아들 유다 왕 아마샤가 여호아하스의 아들 이스라엘 왕 여호아스가 죽은 뒤에 15년 동안 살았다.
ko.B: 요아스의 아들 유다 왕 아마샤는 여호아하스의 아들 이스라엘 왕 여호아스가 죽은 뒤에도 15년을 더 살았다.
ko.R: 여호아하스의 아들 이스라엘 왕 여호아스가 죽은 뒤에도 요아스의 아들 유다 왕 아마샤는 15년을 더 살았다.

pt.L: E Amazias, filho de Joás, rei de Judá, viveu depois da morte de Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, rei de Israel, quinze anos.
pt.B: Amazias, filho de Joás, rei de Judá, viveu quinze anos depois da morte de Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, rei de Israel.
pt.R: Amazias, filho de Joás, rei de Judá, viveu mais quinze anos depois que Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, rei de Israel, morreu.

decisions.choice: fifteen years after Jehoash: Amaziah outlived the king who defeated him
decisions.reason: Amaziah reigned twenty-nine years (verse 2), and Jeroboam son of Jehoash became king in Amaziah's fifteenth year (verse 23). The verse notes that the defeated king lived on long after the victor.

decisions.choice: the number of years moved forward
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put "fifteen years" next to the verb; Literal keeps it at the end, as the Hebrew does.

source.text: וְיֶ֖תֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲמַצְיָ֑הוּ הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Amaziah, [are] not they written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of the kings of Judah?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Amaziah are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
en.R: Everything else Amaziah did is written in the history of the kings of Judah.

es.L: Y los demás hechos de Amasías, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Judá?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Amasías están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Judá.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Amasías está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Judá.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes d’Amatsia, n’est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes d’Amatsia est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda.
fr.R: Tout le reste de ce qu’a fait Amatsia a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Amazia, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Yuda?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Amazia yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Yuda.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyoyafanya Amazia yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Yuda.

vi.L: Các việc khác của A-ma-xia chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Giu-đa sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của A-ma-xia đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác A-ma-xia đã làm đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 아마샤의 나머지 일들은 유다 왕들의 날들의 일을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 아마샤의 나머지 행적은 유다 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 아마샤가 한 나머지 일은 유다 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Amazias, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
pt.B: Os demais atos de Amazias estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Judá.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Amazias fez está escrito na história dos reis de Judá.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah
decisions.reason: The royal record of Judah, now lost, as at 12:20.

decisions.choice: a statement in place of the question
decisions.reason: As in verse 15.

decisions.choice: "유다 왕들의 날들의 일을 적은 책" (L); "유다 왕 실록" (B); "유다 왕들의 역사를 적은 책" (R)
decisions.reason: The same pattern as the book of the kings of Israel (13:8).

source.text: וַיִּקְשְׁר֨וּ עָלָ֥יו קֶ֛שֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַיָּ֣נָס לָכִ֑ישָׁה וַיִּשְׁלְח֤וּ אַֽחֲרָיו֙ לָכִ֔ישָׁה וַיְמִתֻ֖הוּ שָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they conspired against him a conspiracy in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; and they sent after him to Lachish and put him to death there.

en.L: And they conspired a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; and they sent after him to Lachish and put him to death there.
en.B: Some in Jerusalem formed a conspiracy against him, and he fled to Lachish. But they sent men after him to Lachish and put him to death there.
en.R: Some people in Jerusalem made a plot against Amaziah, so he ran away to the town of Lachish. But they sent men after him to Lachish, and they killed him there.

es.L: Y conspiraron contra él una conspiración en Jerusalén, y él huyó a Laquis; y enviaron tras él a Laquis, y allí le dieron muerte.
es.B: Algunos en Jerusalén tramaron una conspiración contra él, y él huyó a Laquis. Pero enviaron hombres tras él a Laquis, y allí le dieron muerte.
es.R: Unas personas de Jerusalén hicieron un complot contra Amasías, así que él huyó a la ciudad de Laquis. Pero enviaron hombres a perseguirlo hasta Laquis, y allí lo mataron.

fr.L: Et ils conspirèrent contre lui une conspiration à Jérusalem, et il s’enfuit à Lakish ; et ils envoyèrent après lui à Lakish et le firent mourir là.
fr.B: À Jérusalem, on forma une conspiration contre lui, et il s’enfuit à Lakish. Mais on envoya des hommes à sa poursuite jusqu’à Lakish, et on l’y fit mourir.
fr.R: À Jérusalem, des gens ont comploté contre Amatsia. Alors il s’est enfui dans la ville de Lakish. Mais ils ont envoyé des hommes à sa poursuite jusqu’à Lakish, et ils l’ont tué là-bas.

sw.L: Nao wakafanya fitina juu yake huko Yerusalemu, naye akakimbilia Lakishi; nao wakatuma watu nyuma yake hata Lakishi, wakamwua huko.
sw.B: Watu fulani huko Yerusalemu walifanya njama dhidi yake, naye akakimbilia Lakishi. Lakini wakatuma watu wamfuate huko Lakishi, wakamwua huko.
sw.R: Watu fulani huko Yerusalemu walipanga njama dhidi ya Amazia, kwa hiyo akakimbilia mji wa Lakishi. Lakini wakatuma watu wamfuate huko Lakishi, nao wakamwua huko.

vi.L: Người ta âm mưu một cuộc mưu phản chống lại ông tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, và ông chạy trốn đến La-ki; nhưng họ sai [người] đuổi theo ông đến La-ki và giết ông tại đó.
vi.B: Có những người tại Giê-ru-sa-lem âm mưu chống lại vua, và vua chạy trốn đến La-ki. Nhưng họ sai người đuổi theo vua đến La-ki và giết vua tại đó.
vi.R: Có một số người ở Giê-ru-sa-lem lập mưu chống lại A-ma-xia, nên ông bỏ chạy đến thành La-ki. Nhưng họ sai người đuổi theo ông đến La-ki và giết ông tại đó.

ko.L: 그리고 사람들이 예루살렘에서 그를 대적하여 반역을 꾀하자, 그가 라기스로 도망쳤다. 그러나 그들이 라기스로 그의 뒤를 쫓아 [사람들을] 보내어 거기에서 그를 죽였다.
ko.B: 예루살렘에서 어떤 사람들이 그를 거슬러 반역을 꾀하자, 그는 라기스로 도망쳤다. 그러나 그들은 라기스까지 사람들을 보내어 그를 뒤쫓게 하여 거기에서 그를 죽였다.
ko.R: 예루살렘에서 어떤 사람들이 아마샤를 해치려고 음모를 꾸몄다. 그래서 그는 라기스 성읍으로 도망쳤다. 그러나 그들은 라기스까지 사람들을 보내어 그를 쫓아가 거기에서 죽였다.

pt.L: E tramaram contra ele uma conspiração em Jerusalém, e ele fugiu para Laquis; e mandaram atrás dele a Laquis e o mataram ali.
pt.B: Alguns em Jerusalém tramaram uma conspiração contra ele, e ele fugiu para Laquis. Mas mandaram homens atrás dele até Laquis e o mataram ali.
pt.R: Algumas pessoas em Jerusalém fizeram planos contra Amazias, e por isso ele fugiu para a cidade de Laquis. Mas elas mandaram homens atrás dele até Laquis, e eles o mataram ali.

decisions.choice: they: the plotters are not named
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. The writer does not say who led the plot or why. 2 Chronicles 25:27 links it with Amaziah's turning away from Yahweh.

decisions.choice: Lachish: a fortified city of Judah
decisions.reason: Lachish was one of Judah's strongest cities, in the low hills southwest of Jerusalem (Joshua 10:31-32; 2 Chronicles 11:9).

decisions.choice: a conspiracy, as against his father
decisions.reason: Amaziah's father Joash was also killed by a conspiracy of his own people (12:21-22).

decisions.choice: sent men after him
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "they sent after him"; Balanced and Readable add "men", who were sent.

decisions.choice: wakatuma watu
decisions.reason: Swahili "kutuma" needs an object; Literal supplies "watu" without brackets, since the verb is incomplete without it.

source.text: וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ עַל־הַסּוּסִ֑ים וַיִּקָּבֵ֧ר בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם עִם־אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֥יר דָּוִֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And they carried him on the horses, and he was buried in Jerusalem with his fathers in [the] city of David.

en.L: And they carried him on the horses, and he was buried in Jerusalem with his fathers in the City of David.
en.B: They brought his body back on horses, and he was buried in Jerusalem with his ancestors in the City of David.
en.R: His body was carried back to Jerusalem on horses. He was buried there with his ancestors in the City of David.

es.L: Y lo trajeron sobre los caballos, y fue sepultado en Jerusalén con sus padres en la ciudad de David.
es.B: Trajeron su cuerpo sobre caballos, y fue sepultado en Jerusalén con sus antepasados en la ciudad de David.
es.R: Su cuerpo fue llevado de vuelta a Jerusalén sobre caballos. Allí fue sepultado con sus antepasados en la ciudad de David.

fr.L: Et ils le transportèrent sur les chevaux, et il fut enterré à Jérusalem avec ses pères, dans la cité de David.
fr.B: On ramena son corps sur des chevaux, et il fut enterré à Jérusalem avec ses ancêtres, dans la cité de David.
fr.R: On a ramené son corps à Jérusalem sur des chevaux. Il a été enterré là avec ses ancêtres, dans la cité de David.

sw.L: Nao wakambeba juu ya farasi, naye akazikwa huko Yerusalemu pamoja na baba zake katika mji wa Daudi.
sw.B: Wakauleta mwili wake juu ya farasi, naye akazikwa huko Yerusalemu pamoja na babu zake katika mji wa Daudi.
sw.R: Mwili wake ulibebwa juu ya farasi hadi Yerusalemu. Akazikwa huko pamoja na babu zake katika mji wa Daudi.

vi.L: Họ chở ông trên ngựa, và ông được chôn tại Giê-ru-sa-lem với tổ phụ mình trong thành Đa-vít.
vi.B: Họ dùng ngựa chở thi hài vua về, và vua được chôn tại Giê-ru-sa-lem với tổ tiên trong thành Đa-vít.
vi.R: Thi hài ông được chở về Giê-ru-sa-lem trên lưng ngựa. Ông được chôn tại đó với tổ tiên mình trong thành Đa-vít.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그를 말들에 실어 왔고, 그는 예루살렘에서 다윗 성에 그의 조상들과 함께 묻혔다.
ko.B: 사람들은 그의 시신을 말에 실어 왔고, 그는 예루살렘 다윗 성에 조상들과 함께 묻혔다.
ko.R: 그의 시신은 말에 실려 예루살렘으로 돌아왔다. 그는 거기 다윗 성에 조상들과 함께 묻혔다.

pt.L: E o carregaram sobre os cavalos, e ele foi sepultado em Jerusalém com os seus pais na Cidade de Davi.
pt.B: Trouxeram o corpo dele de volta sobre cavalos, e ele foi sepultado em Jerusalém com os seus antepassados na Cidade de Davi.
pt.R: O corpo dele foi levado de volta a Jerusalém sobre cavalos. Ele foi sepultado ali com os seus antepassados na Cidade de Davi.

decisions.choice: carried him on the horses: brought the body home with honor
decisions.reason: The king's body was brought back to Jerusalem by horse, perhaps on a chariot or a litter pulled by horses. Though his own people had killed him, he was buried as a king.

decisions.choice: the City of David: the oldest part of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The kings of Judah were buried in the City of David, the hill David took from the Jebusites (2 Samuel 5:7-9; 1 Kings 2:10).

decisions.choice: his body
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "his body" for "him", since Amaziah was already dead.

source.text: וַיִּקְח֞וּ כָּל־עַ֤ם יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת־עֲזַרְיָ֔ה וְה֕וּא בֶּן־שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַיַּמְלִ֣כוּ אֹת֔וֹ תַּ֖חַת אָבִ֥יו אֲמַצְיָֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And took all [the] people of Judah Azariah, and he [was] a son of sixteen year[s], and they made king him in place of his father Amaziah.

en.L: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, and he [was] sixteen years old, and they made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
en.B: Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, then sixteen years old, and made him king to succeed his father Amaziah.
en.R: Then all the people of Judah chose Azariah, Amaziah's son, and made him king in his father's place. Azariah was sixteen years old.

es.L: Y todo el pueblo de Judá tomó a Azarías, que [tenía] dieciséis años, y lo hicieron rey en lugar de su padre Amasías.
es.B: Entonces todo el pueblo de Judá tomó a Azarías, que tenía dieciséis años, y lo hicieron rey en lugar de su padre Amasías.
es.R: Entonces todo el pueblo de Judá escogió a Azarías, hijo de Amasías, y lo hizo rey en lugar de su padre. Azarías tenía dieciséis años.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple de Juda prit Azaria, et il [était] âgé de seize ans, et ils le firent roi à la place de son père Amatsia.
fr.B: Alors tout le peuple de Juda prit Azaria, qui avait seize ans, et le fit roi pour succéder à son père Amatsia.
fr.R: Alors tout le peuple de Juda a choisi Azaria, le fils d’Amatsia, et l’a fait roi à la place de son père. Azaria avait seize ans.

sw.L: Na watu wote wa Yuda wakamchukua Azaria, naye [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka kumi na sita, wakamtawaza kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake Amazia.
sw.B: Kisha watu wote wa Yuda walimchukua Azaria, aliyekuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na sita wakati huo, wakamtawaza kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake Amazia.
sw.R: Kisha watu wote wa Yuda walimchagua Azaria, mwana wa Amazia, wakamtawaza kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake. Azaria alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na sita.

vi.L: Toàn dân Giu-đa lấy A-xa-ria, ông [được] mười sáu tuổi, và họ lập ông làm vua thay cha ông là A-ma-xia.
vi.B: Bấy giờ toàn dân Giu-đa lập A-xa-ria, lúc ấy mười sáu tuổi, lên làm vua kế vị cha là A-ma-xia.
vi.R: Rồi toàn dân Giu-đa chọn A-xa-ria, con trai A-ma-xia, và lập ông làm vua thay cha mình. A-xa-ria được mười sáu tuổi.

ko.L: 그리고 유다의 온 백성이 아사랴를 데려왔다. 그는 16세[였다]. 그리고 그들이 그의 아버지 아마샤를 대신하여 그를 왕으로 삼았다.
ko.B: 그러자 유다의 온 백성이 그때 16세였던 아사랴를 데려다가 그의 아버지 아마샤의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다.
ko.R: 그러자 유다의 온 백성이 아마샤의 아들 아사랴를 골라 그의 아버지의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다. 아사랴는 16세였다.

pt.L: E todo o povo de Judá tomou Azarias, e ele [tinha] dezesseis anos, e o fizeram rei em lugar do seu pai Amazias.
pt.B: Então todo o povo de Judá tomou Azarias, que tinha dezesseis anos, e o fez rei no lugar do seu pai Amazias.
pt.R: Então todo o povo de Judá escolheu Azarias, filho de Amazias, e o fez rei no lugar do pai. Azarias tinha dezesseis anos.

decisions.choice: Azariah: the king also called Uzziah
decisions.reason: Kings mostly calls this king Azariah (15:1, 6-8, 17, 23, 27) but also Uzziah (15:13, 30, 32, 34). Chronicles and the prophets call him Uzziah (2 Chronicles 26:1; Isaiah 1:1; 6:1; Hosea 1:1; Amos 1:1). The two names are close in meaning, "Yahweh has helped" and "Yahweh is my strength", and both name the same king. Every level keeps the form this verse uses.

decisions.choice: all the people of Judah: the nation acting together
decisions.reason: The people, not the plotters, chose the next king, and they chose Amaziah's son. So David's line went on, as when the people of the land made Joash king (11:14-20).

decisions.choice: a son of sixteen years: sixteen years old
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: chose
decisions.reason: Readable says "chose" for "took": the people took Azariah to be their king. It also names him as Amaziah's son and gives his age in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "Azarías"
decisions.reason: The name each verse uses is kept at every level, as the terms note sets: "Azarías" here, "Uzías" where Kings says Uzziah (m1).

decisions.choice: Azaria
decisions.reason: Kings calls this king Azariah, Chronicles and Isaiah Uzziah (m1); the French keeps the form each verse uses, Azaria here and Ozias where the Hebrew says Uzziah, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: A-xa-ria (Azariah), called Ô-xia (Uzziah) in other verses
decisions.reason: The king keeps the form each verse uses, as the terms note sets: A-xa-ria here, Ô-xia where the Hebrew says Uzziah.

decisions.choice: "아사랴" where Kings has Azariah; "웃시야" where a verse has Uzziah
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps the name each verse uses, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Azarias where the Hebrew says Azariah; Uzias where it says Uzziah
decisions.reason: For the whole book (15:1-34): Kings gives this king two names (m1), and Portuguese keeps each name where the Hebrew and the English use it, as the shared list for Kings has both: "Azarias" here and in 15:1-27, "Uzias" in 15:13, 30-34, the name readers know from Isaiah. The meaning notes say that both name one king. Unlike the two kings named Joash (12:1), no other king bears either name, so nothing is gained by changing the Hebrew's choice.

source.text: ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת־אֵילַ֔ת וַיְשִׁבֶ֖הָ לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֥י שְׁכַֽב־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם־אֲבֹתָֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: He built Elath and restored it to Judah, after lay down the king with his fathers.

en.L: He built Elath and restored it to Judah, after the king lay down with his fathers.
en.B: It was he who rebuilt Elath and won it back for Judah, after King Amaziah had rested with his ancestors.
en.R: After his father Amaziah died, Azariah rebuilt the town of Elath and made it part of Judah again.

es.L: Él edificó Elat y la restituyó a Judá, después que el rey durmió con sus padres.
es.B: Fue él quien reconstruyó Elat y la recuperó para Judá, después de que el rey Amasías descansó con sus antepasados.
es.R: Después de que murió su padre Amasías, Azarías reconstruyó la ciudad de Elat y la hizo otra vez parte de Judá.

fr.L: C’est lui qui bâtit Élath et la rendit à Juda, après que le roi se fut couché avec ses pères.
fr.B: C’est lui qui rebâtit Élath et la rendit à Juda, après que le roi Amatsia eut reposé avec ses ancêtres.
fr.R: Après la mort de son père Amatsia, Azaria a reconstruit la ville d’Élath et l’a rendue à Juda.

sw.L: Yeye ndiye aliyeijenga Elathi na kuirudisha kwa Yuda, baada ya mfalme kulala pamoja na baba zake.
sw.B: Yeye ndiye aliyeijenga upya Elathi na kuirudisha kwa Yuda, baada ya mfalme Amazia kupumzika pamoja na babu zake.
sw.R: Baada ya baba yake Amazia kufa, Azaria aliujenga upya mji wa Elathi na kuufanya tena kuwa sehemu ya Yuda.

vi.L: Ông xây Ê-lát và trả nó lại cho Giu-đa, sau khi vua nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình.
vi.B: Chính ông đã xây lại Ê-lát và thu hồi thành ấy cho Giu-đa, sau khi vua A-ma-xia an giấc cùng tổ tiên.
vi.R: Sau khi A-ma-xia cha ông qua đời, A-xa-ria xây lại thành Ê-lát và đưa thành ấy về lại với Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그가 엘랏을 건축하여 그것을 유다에 되돌렸다. 왕이 그의 조상들과 함께 누운 뒤였다.
ko.B: 엘랏을 다시 건축하여 유다에 되돌려 놓은 사람이 바로 그였다. 그것은 아마샤 왕이 조상들과 함께 잠든 뒤의 일이었다.
ko.R: 그의 아버지 아마샤가 죽은 뒤에, 아사랴는 엘랏 성읍을 다시 짓고 그곳을 다시 유다 땅으로 만들었다.

pt.L: Ele edificou Elate e a restituiu a Judá, depois que o rei descansou com os seus pais.
pt.B: Foi ele que reconstruiu Elate e a recuperou para Judá, depois que o rei Amazias descansou com os seus antepassados.
pt.R: Depois que o seu pai Amazias morreu, Azarias reconstruiu a cidade de Elate e fez com que ela voltasse a ser de Judá.

decisions.choice: he: Azariah; the king: Amaziah
decisions.reason: The stressed pronoun "he" points to Azariah, just named in verse 21. "The king" who lay down with his fathers is Amaziah: Azariah did this after his father's death, finishing what the victory over Edom (verse 7) had begun.

decisions.choice: Elath: Judah's port on the Red Sea
decisions.reason: Elath stood at the head of the Gulf of Aqaba, near Ezion-geber, where Solomon kept his ships (Deuteronomy 2:8; 1 Kings 9:26). Judah lost it when Edom broke away (8:20-22), and later lost it again (16:6).

decisions.choice: built: rebuilt, fortified
decisions.reason: The town already existed; "build" here means to rebuild and strengthen it.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The death formula, as in verse 16.

decisions.choice: It was he (Balanced); Amaziah; Azariah
decisions.reason: Balanced shows the stress on "he" and names King Amaziah; Readable names both kings so the reader does not confuse them (m1). Readable says "died" for the death formula.

source.text: בִּשְׁנַת֙ חֲמֵשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַאֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ יָרָבְעָ֨ם בֶּן־יוֹאָ֤שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְאַחַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In year fifteen year of Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah reigned Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel in Samaria forty and one year[s].

en.L: In [the] fifteenth year of Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel reigned in Samaria forty-one years.
en.B: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam son of Joash became king over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned forty-one years.
en.R: Jeroboam son of Joash became king of Israel in the fifteenth year that Amaziah son of Joash was king of Judah. Jeroboam ruled from Samaria for forty-one years.

es.L: En el año quince de Amasías hijo de Joás, rey de Judá, reinó Jeroboam hijo de Joás, rey de Israel, en Samaria cuarenta y un años.
es.B: En el año quince de Amasías hijo de Joás, rey de Judá, Jeroboam hijo de Joás comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en Samaria, y reinó cuarenta y un años.
es.R: Jeroboam hijo de Joás comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en el año quince del reinado de Amasías hijo de Joás en Judá. Jeroboam gobernó desde Samaria durante cuarenta y un años.

fr.L: En la quinzième année d’Amatsia fils de Joas, roi de Juda, Jéroboam fils de Joas, roi d’Israël, régna à Samarie quarante et un ans.
fr.B: La quinzième année du règne d’Amatsia, fils de Joas, roi de Juda, Jéroboam, fils de Joas, devint roi d’Israël à Samarie ; il régna quarante et un ans.
fr.R: Jéroboam fils de Joas est devenu roi d’Israël la quinzième année du règne d’Amatsia fils de Joas, roi de Juda. Jéroboam a régné à Samarie pendant quarante et un ans.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa kumi na tano wa Amazia mwana wa Yoashi mfalme wa Yuda, Yeroboamu mwana wa Yoashi mfalme wa Israeli alitawala huko Samaria miaka arobaini na mmoja.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa kumi na tano wa Amazia mwana wa Yoashi mfalme wa Yuda, Yeroboamu mwana wa Yoashi alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria, akatawala miaka arobaini na mmoja.
sw.R: Yeroboamu mwana wa Yoashi alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli katika mwaka wa kumi na tano wa utawala wa Amazia mwana wa Yoashi mfalme wa Yuda. Yeroboamu alitawala akiwa Samaria kwa miaka arobaini na mmoja.

vi.L: Năm thứ mười lăm đời A-ma-xia con trai Giô-ách vua Giu-đa, Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên trị vì tại Sa-ma-ri bốn mươi mốt năm.
vi.B: Năm thứ mười lăm đời A-ma-xia con trai Giô-ách vua Giu-đa, Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri và trị vì bốn mươi mốt năm.
vi.R: Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên vào năm thứ mười lăm đời A-ma-xia con trai Giô-ách làm vua Giu-đa. Giê-rô-bô-am cai trị tại Sa-ma-ri bốn mươi mốt năm.

ko.L: 요아스의 아들 유다 왕 아마샤의 제15년에 요아스의 아들 이스라엘 왕 여로보암이 사마리아에서 41년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.B: 요아스의 아들 유다 왕 아마샤가 다스린 지 15년째 되는 해에 요아스의 아들 여로보암이 사마리아에서 이스라엘의 왕이 되어 41년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 요아스의 아들 유다 왕 아마샤가 다스린 지 15년째 되는 해에 요아스의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘의 왕이 되었다. 여로보암은 사마리아에서 41년 동안 다스렸다.

pt.L: No décimo quinto ano de Amazias, filho de Joás, rei de Judá, Jeroboão, filho de Jeoás, rei de Israel, reinou em Samaria quarenta e um anos.
pt.B: No décimo quinto ano de Amazias, filho de Joás, rei de Judá, Jeroboão, filho de Jeoás, começou a reinar sobre Israel em Samaria, e reinou quarenta e um anos.
pt.R: Jeroboão, filho de Jeoás, se tornou rei de Israel no décimo quinto ano em que Amazias, filho de Joás, era rei de Judá. Jeroboão governou em Samaria durante quarenta e um anos.

decisions.choice: reigned ... forty-one years: became king and reigned forty-one years
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:33, the one verb covers both the start of the reign and its length.

decisions.choice: forty-one years: the longest reign in Israel
decisions.reason: No other king of the northern kingdom ruled as long. His years were a time of strength and wide borders (verses 25, 28).

decisions.choice: son of Joash: Jehoash king of Israel
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the short form of the name here; this is the Jehoash of verses 8-16, and the verse keeps its own form of the name (see verse 1).

decisions.choice: and he reigned
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "and he reigned" before the number of years, as in the accession formula throughout these books.

decisions.choice: Jeroboão, filho de Jeoás
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the short form of his father's name (m3); Portuguese writes "Jeoás" for the king of Israel in every verse (13:9), so the reader sees at once that this Jeroboam is the son of the king of verses 8-16, not of Jeroboam son of Nebat's line.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מִכָּל־חַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh; not he turned aside from all [the] sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat which he caused to sin Israel.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; he did not turn aside from all the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who made Israel sin.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who led Israel to sin.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil. He did not stop committing any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who led Israel into sin.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; no se apartó de ninguno de los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, que hizo pecar a Israel.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. No se apartó de ninguno de los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, que hizo cometer pecado a Israel.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba. No dejó de cometer ninguno de los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, que hizo pecar a Israel.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; il ne se détourna d’aucun des péchés de Jéroboam fils de Nebath, qui avait fait pécher Israël.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il ne se détourna d’aucun des péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui avait fait commettre le péché à Israël.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais. Il n’a cessé de commettre aucun des péchés de Jéroboam fils de Nebath, qui avait fait commettre le péché à Israël.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; hakugeuka kuziacha dhambi zote za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, aliyewafanya Israeli kutenda dhambi.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hakuiacha hata moja ya dhambi za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, aliyewafanya Israeli kutenda dhambi.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya. Hakuacha kutenda dhambi zote za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, aliyewaongoza Israeli kutenda dhambi.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; ông không lìa bỏ mọi tội của Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, là người đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm tội.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ông không từ bỏ tội nào trong các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, là người đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm tội.
vi.R: Ông làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác. Ông không chừa bỏ tội nào trong các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, là người đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm tội.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다. 그는 이스라엘에게 죄를 짓게 한 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 모든 죄에서 떠나지 않았다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다. 그는 이스라엘에게 죄를 짓게 한 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 죄를 하나도 버리지 않았다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다. 그는 이스라엘에게 죄를 짓게 한 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 죄를 하나도 그만두지 않았다.

pt.L: E fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; não se desviou de todos os pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com os quais fez Israel pecar.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Não se afastou de nenhum dos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com os quais este fez Israel pecar.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau. Não abandonou nenhum dos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, os pecados com que Jeroboão tinha levado Israel a pecar.

decisions.choice: did what was evil in Yahweh's eyes: the bad verdict
decisions.reason: Every king of Israel receives this verdict. Jeroboam's long and successful reign does not change it.

decisions.choice: the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin
decisions.reason: The first Jeroboam set up golden calves at Bethel and Dan and his own priests and feasts (1 Kings 12:28-33). Every king of Israel kept them, and Kings counts it as the sin that brought the kingdom to its end (17:21-23). The verse names the first Jeroboam by his father to set him apart from Jeroboam son of Jehoash.

decisions.choice: made Israel sin / led Israel to sin / led Israel into sin
decisions.reason: As at 3:3: the formula about Jeroboam son of Nebat is worded the same way at each level wherever it recurs.

decisions.choice: did the evil in [the] eyes of / did what was evil in the sight of / did what the LORD said was evil
decisions.reason: The bad verdict is worded the same way at each level throughout these books.

decisions.choice: "hizo lo malo a los ojos del SEÑOR" (L, B); "hizo lo que el SEÑOR reprueba" (R); "que hizo pecar a Israel"
decisions.reason: The verdict and the sin of Jeroboam keep one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets them.

source.text: ה֗וּא הֵשִׁיב֙ אֶת־גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִלְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֖ת עַד־יָ֣ם הָעֲרָבָ֑ה כִּדְבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֗ר בְּיַד־עַבְדּ֞וֹ יוֹנָ֤ה בֶן־אֲמִתַּי֙ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִגַּ֥ת הַחֵֽפֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: He restored [the] border of Israel from Lebo-hamath to [the] sea of the Arabah, according to [the] word of Yahweh God of Israel which he spoke by [the] hand of his servant Jonah son of Amittai the prophet who [was] from Gath-hepher.

en.L: He restored the border of Israel from Lebo-hamath to the Sea of the Arabah, according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke by the hand of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} slave Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet who [was] from Gath-hepher.
en.B: He restored the border of Israel from Lebo-hamath to the Sea of the Arabah, by the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had spoken through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath-hepher.
en.R: Jeroboam won back Israel's land, from Lebo-hamath in the north to the Dead Sea in the south. This was what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel had promised through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant, the prophet Jonah son of Amittai, from Gath-hepher.

es.L: Él restituyó el territorio de Israel desde Lebo-hamat hasta el mar del Arabá, conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habló por mano de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Jonás hijo de Amitay, el profeta que [era] de Gat-héfer.
es.B: Él restableció las fronteras de Israel desde Lebo-hamat hasta el mar del Arabá, conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había dicho por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Jonás hijo de Amitay, el profeta de Gat-héfer.
es.R: Jeroboam recuperó el territorio de Israel, desde Lebo-hamat en el norte hasta el mar Muerto en el sur. Así se cumplió lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, había prometido por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, el profeta Jonás hijo de Amitay, de Gat-héfer.

fr.L: C’est lui qui rétablit la frontière d’Israël depuis Lebo-Hamath jusqu’à la mer de la Araba, selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dite par la main de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} esclave Jonas fils d’Amittaï, le prophète qui [était] de Gath-Hépher.
fr.B: Il rétablit la frontière d’Israël depuis Lebo-Hamath jusqu’à la mer de la Araba, conformément à la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait prononcée par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur Jonas, fils d’Amittaï, le prophète de Gath-Hépher.
fr.R: Jéroboam a reconquis le territoire d’Israël, depuis Lebo-Hamath au nord jusqu’à la mer Morte au sud. C’était ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, avait promis par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, le prophète Jonas fils d’Amittaï, de Gath-Hépher.

sw.L: Yeye aliurudisha mpaka wa Israeli kutoka Lebo-hamathi mpaka bahari ya Araba, sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, alilolinena kwa mkono wa mtumwa {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Yona mwana wa Amitai, nabii aliyekuwa wa Gath-heferi.
sw.B: Aliurudisha mpaka wa Israeli kutoka Lebo-hamathi mpaka bahari ya Araba, sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, alilokuwa amelinena kupitia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Yona mwana wa Amitai, nabii wa Gath-heferi.
sw.R: Yeroboamu aliirudisha nchi ya Israeli, kutoka Lebo-hamathi upande wa kaskazini mpaka Bahari ya Chumvi upande wa kusini. Hivyo ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, alivyokuwa ameahidi kupitia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, nabii Yona mwana wa Amitai, wa Gath-heferi.

vi.L: Ông khôi phục bờ cõi Y-sơ-ra-ên từ Lê-bô Ha-mát đến Biển A-ra-ba, theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán qua tay đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Giô-na con trai A-mi-tai, nhà tiên tri [người] Gát-Hê-phe.
vi.B: Ông khôi phục bờ cõi Y-sơ-ra-ên từ Lê-bô Ha-mát đến Biển A-ra-ba, đúng như lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán qua đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Giô-na con trai A-mi-tai, nhà tiên tri ở Gát-Hê-phe.
vi.R: Giê-rô-bô-am giành lại đất đai của Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ Lê-bô Ha-mát ở phía bắc đến Biển Chết ở phía nam. Đó là điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, đã hứa qua đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là nhà tiên tri Giô-na con trai A-mi-tai, người Gát-Hê-phe.

ko.L: 그가 르보하맛에서 아라바 바다까지 이스라엘의 경계를 회복했다. 이는 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 종, 가드헤벨 출신 예언자인 아밋대의 아들 요나의 손으로 하신 말씀대로였다.
ko.B: 그는 르보하맛에서 아라바 바다까지 이스라엘의 경계를 회복했다. 이것은 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 종, 가드헤벨 출신의 예언자 아밋대의 아들 요나를 통하여 하신 말씀대로였다.
ko.R: 여로보암은 북쪽 르보하맛에서 남쪽 사해까지 이스라엘의 땅을 되찾았다. 이것은 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 종, 가드헤벨 출신의 예언자 아밋대의 아들 요나를 통하여 약속하신 일이었다.

pt.L: Ele restabeleceu a fronteira de Israel, desde Lebo-Hamate até o mar da Arabá, segundo a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou pela mão do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} escravo Jonas, filho de Amitai, o profeta que [era] de Gate-Héfer.
pt.B: Ele restabeleceu a fronteira de Israel, desde Lebo-Hamate até o mar da Arabá, conforme {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, tinha dito por meio do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo Jonas, filho de Amitai, o profeta de Gate-Héfer.
pt.R: Jeroboão reconquistou a terra de Israel, desde Lebo-Hamate, no norte, até o mar Morto, no sul. Foi isso que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, tinha prometido por meio do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo, o profeta Jonas, filho de Amitai, de Gate-Héfer.

decisions.choice: from Lebo-hamath to the Sea of the Arabah: the old borders restored
decisions.reason: Lebo-hamath, "the entrance of Hamath", in the far north, was the northern limit of the land in Solomon's day (Numbers 34:8; 1 Kings 8:65). The Sea of the Arabah is the Dead Sea (Deuteronomy 3:17; Joshua 3:16). Jeroboam won back land lost to Aram (10:32-33; 13:22-25).

decisions.choice: Jonah son of Amittai: the prophet of the book of Jonah
decisions.reason: This is the same prophet whom Yahweh sent to Nineveh (Jonah 1:1). The word he spoke about Israel's borders is not recorded elsewhere.

decisions.choice: Gath-hepher: a town in Zebulun
decisions.reason: Gath-hepher lay in the hills of Galilee, in the land of Zebulun (Joshua 19:13).

decisions.choice: by the hand of: through
decisions.reason: Yahweh spoke through the prophet as his messenger.

decisions.choice: slave (Literal); servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As for Moses and the prophets elsewhere, the Literal level keeps "slave" and the other levels say "servant".

decisions.choice: in the north; the Dead Sea in the south
decisions.reason: Readable gives the familiar name of the Sea of the Arabah and says where the two limits lay (m1).

decisions.choice: "siervo"
decisions.reason: As the Psalms terms note sets for Spanish, God's servants are "siervo" at every level, Literal included, where the English Literal says "slave".

decisions.choice: "Jonás hijo de Amitay", "Gat-héfer", "Lebo-hamat", "el mar del Arabá" (L, B); "el mar Muerto" (R)
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish forms; Jonah is "Jonás" as in the New Testament. Readable names the Dead Sea, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "esclave" (L); "serviteur" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English and the French Pentateuch note, *ʿeved* is "esclave" at Literal and "serviteur" at Balanced and Readable for a prophet as the LORD's servant.

decisions.choice: mtumwa (Literal); mtumishi (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Samuel choice for *ʿeved*: "mtumwa" at Literal, "mtumishi" at Balanced and Readable, as the English has "slave" and "servant".

decisions.choice: Bahari ya Chumvi
decisions.reason: Readable gives the Sea of the Arabah its familiar name, the Salt Sea, as the English says "the Dead Sea".

decisions.choice: nô lệ (L); đầy tớ (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English, Literal keeps "slave" for the prophet as God's servant and the other levels say "đầy tớ".

decisions.choice: "그분의 종" at every level
decisions.reason: The Psalms and Samuel notes give *ʿeved* as "종" for God's servants at every level; Korean "종" already holds the slave sense the English Literal brings out.

decisions.choice: Jonas, filho de Amitai, o profeta de Gate-Héfer; Lebo-Hamate; o mar da Arabá (L, B), o mar Morto (R)
decisions.reason: The prophet is the Jonah of the book of Jonah (m2), so he bears the name Portuguese gives him there and in Matthew 12:39-41, "Jonas", and his father is "Amitai". His town is "Gate-Héfer", as Joshua 19:13 has it in Portuguese (m3). The borders (m1) take the forms of Numbers 34:8 ("Lebo-Hamate") and Deuteronomy 3:17 ("o mar da Arabá"), with Readable's "o mar Morto". Balanced keeps the fulfilment formula of 1 Kings 14:18, "conforme o SENHOR tinha dito", with no pronoun where the English has one.

source.text: כִּי־רָאָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־עֳנִ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֹרֶ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וְאֶ֤פֶס עָצוּר֙ וְאֶ֣פֶס עָז֔וּב וְאֵ֥ין עֹזֵ֖ר לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: For saw Yahweh the affliction of Israel, very bitter, and [there was] none shut up and none left free, and there was no helper for Israel.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} saw the affliction of Israel, [that it was] very bitter; and [there was] none, bound or free, and there was no helper for Israel.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} saw that Israel's suffering was very bitter. No one was left, bound or free, and there was no one to help Israel.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} saw how bitterly Israel was suffering. Everyone was helpless, and there was no one to help Israel.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vio la aflicción de Israel, [que era] muy amarga; y no [había] nadie, ni esclavo ni libre, y no había quien ayudara a Israel.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vio que el sufrimiento de Israel era muy amargo. No quedaba nadie, ni esclavo ni libre, y no había quien ayudara a Israel.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vio cuán amargamente sufría Israel. Todos estaban indefensos, y no había nadie que ayudara a Israel.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vit l’affliction d’Israël, [qui était] très amère ; et [il n’y avait] plus personne, ni esclave ni libre, et il n’y avait personne pour aider Israël.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} voyait combien la détresse d’Israël était amère. Il ne restait plus personne, ni esclave ni homme libre, et personne ne venait en aide à Israël.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a vu combien Israël souffrait. Tout le monde était sans défense, et personne ne pouvait aider Israël.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyaona mateso ya Israeli, [kwamba yalikuwa] machungu sana; wala hapakuwa na mtu, aliyefungwa wala aliye huru, wala hapakuwa na msaidizi kwa Israeli.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliona kwamba mateso ya Israeli yalikuwa machungu sana. Hakuna aliyebaki, aliyefungwa wala aliye huru, wala hapakuwa na mtu wa kuwasaidia Israeli.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliona jinsi Israeli walivyokuwa wakiteseka vikali. Kila mtu alikuwa hana msaada, wala hapakuwa na mtu wa kuwasaidia Israeli.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thấy nỗi khốn khổ của Y-sơ-ra-ên [là] rất cay đắng; không còn ai, kẻ bị giam hay người tự do, và không có ai giúp đỡ Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thấy nỗi khốn khổ của Y-sơ-ra-ên thật cay đắng. Không còn ai, dù nô lệ hay tự do, và không có ai giúp đỡ Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thấy Y-sơ-ra-ên đau khổ cay đắng biết bao. Mọi người đều bất lực, và không có ai giúp đỡ Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 이는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘의 고난이 매우 쓰라린 것을 보셨기 때문이다. 갇힌 자도 풀려난 자도 없었고, 이스라엘을 도울 자가 없었다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘이 겪는 고난이 몹시 쓰라린 것을 보셨기 때문이다. 매인 자도 자유로운 자도 남지 않았고, 이스라엘을 도울 사람이 아무도 없었다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이스라엘이 몹시 고통당하는 것을 보셨다. 모두가 아무 힘도 없었고, 이스라엘을 도와줄 사람이 아무도 없었다.

pt.L: Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} viu a aflição de Israel, [que era] muito amarga; e não [havia] ninguém, preso ou livre, e não havia quem ajudasse Israel.
pt.B: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} viu que o sofrimento de Israel era muito amargo. Não tinha sobrado ninguém, nem preso nem livre, e não havia ninguém para ajudar Israel.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} viu como Israel estava sofrendo amargamente. Todos estavam indefesos, e não havia ninguém para ajudar Israel.

decisions.choice: very bitter
decisions.reason: The word as it is written can also be read as "rebellious", but the sense here is the bitterness of Israel's suffering. It is taken as a form of the common word for "bitter".

decisions.choice: none, bound or free: no one left at all; the words of Deuteronomy 32:36
decisions.reason: The pair "bound or free" means everyone without exception (1 Kings 14:10). The whole phrase echoes Deuteronomy 32:36, where Yahweh takes pity on his people when he sees that "none is left, bound or free". Here he does just that.

decisions.choice: Yahweh saw the affliction of Israel
decisions.reason: As he saw Israel's affliction in Egypt (Exodus 3:7) and under Hazael (13:4), Yahweh saw their suffering and acted, though their king did evil.

decisions.choice: Everyone was helpless
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the pair "bound or free" (m2) without the picture, as at Deuteronomy 32:36.

decisions.choice: "ni esclave ni libre"
decisions.reason: The pair means no one at all, as in Deuteronomy 32:36 (m2); French uses the common contrast slave and free for "shut up and left free".

decisions.choice: ninguém, preso ou livre (L); não tinha sobrado ninguém, nem preso nem livre (B)
decisions.reason: The phrase echoes Deuteronomy 32:36 (m2), so each level keeps the words that verse has in Portuguese, "preso ou livre" and "não sobrou ninguém, nem preso nem livre"; Readable gives the sense, as there.

source.text: וְלֹא־דִבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לִמְחוֹת֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיּ֣וֹשִׁיעֵ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד יָרָבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־יוֹאָֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And not had spoken Yahweh to blot out the name of Israel from under the heavens, and he saved them by [the] hand of Jeroboam son of Joash.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had not spoken of blotting out the name of Israel from under the heavens, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saved them by the hand of Jeroboam son of Joash.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} had not said that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would blot out the name of Israel from under the heavens, so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saved them through Jeroboam son of Joash.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} had not said that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would wipe out the name of Israel from the earth. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rescued them through Jeroboam son of Joash.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no había hablado de borrar el nombre de Israel de debajo del cielo, y los salvó por mano de Jeroboam hijo de Joás.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no había dicho que borraría el nombre de Israel de debajo del cielo, así que los salvó por medio de Jeroboam hijo de Joás.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no había dicho que haría desaparecer el nombre de Israel de la tierra. Por eso los rescató por medio de Jeroboam hijo de Joás.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’avait pas parlé d’effacer le nom d’Israël de dessous les cieux, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les sauva par la main de Jéroboam fils de Joas.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’avait pas dit qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} effacerait le nom d’Israël de dessous les cieux ; aussi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les sauva par Jéroboam, fils de Joas.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’avait pas dit qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ferait disparaître le nom d’Israël de la terre. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a délivré les Israélites par l’intermédiaire de Jéroboam fils de Joas.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakuwa amesema kwamba atalifuta jina la Israeli chini ya mbingu, naye akawaokoa kwa mkono wa Yeroboamu mwana wa Yoashi.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakuwa amesema kwamba angelifuta jina la Israeli chini ya mbingu, kwa hiyo akawaokoa kupitia Yeroboamu mwana wa Yoashi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakuwa amesema kwamba angelifutilia mbali jina la Israeli duniani. Kwa hiyo akawaokoa kupitia Yeroboamu mwana wa Yoashi.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã không phán sẽ xóa tên Y-sơ-ra-ên khỏi dưới trời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu họ bởi tay Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã không phán rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ xóa tên Y-sơ-ra-ên khỏi dưới trời, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu họ qua Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã không nói rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ xóa sạch tên Y-sơ-ra-ên khỏi mặt đất. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu họ qua Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 하늘 아래에서 이스라엘의 이름을 지워 버리겠다고 말씀하지 않으셨다. 그래서 그분께서는 요아스의 아들 여로보암의 손으로 그들을 구원하셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 하늘 아래에서 이스라엘의 이름을 지워 버리겠다고 말씀하지 않으셨으므로, 요아스의 아들 여로보암을 통하여 그들을 구원하셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이 세상에서 이스라엘의 이름을 없애 버리겠다고 말씀하지 않으셨다. 그래서 그분께서는 요아스의 아들 여로보암을 통하여 그들을 구해 주셨다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não tinha falado de apagar o nome de Israel de debaixo dos céus, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os salvou pela mão de Jeroboão, filho de Jeoás.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} não tinha dito que apagaria o nome de Israel de debaixo do céu; por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os salvou por meio de Jeroboão, filho de Jeoás.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} não tinha dito que ia apagar o nome de Israel da terra. Por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os salvou por meio de Jeroboão, filho de Jeoás.

decisions.choice: blot out the name from under heaven: destroy completely, so that not even the memory remains
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of utter destruction (Deuteronomy 9:14; 29:19). Yahweh had not yet decreed that end for Israel.

decisions.choice: Yahweh had not said: not yet
decisions.reason: Israel's end would come about forty years later, when Assyria took Samaria (17:6-18). For now Yahweh showed mercy, as he had for the sake of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob (13:23).

decisions.choice: by the hand of Jeroboam: through Jeroboam
decisions.reason: Jeroboam was the means Yahweh used, though he did evil (verse 24).

decisions.choice: wipe out the name of Israel from the earth
decisions.reason: Readable says "wipe out" and "from the earth" for "blot out" and "from under the heavens".

source.text: וְיֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י יָרָבְעָ֜ם וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ וּגְבוּרָת֣וֹ אֲשֶׁר־נִלְחָ֔ם וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵשִׁ֜יב אֶת־דַּמֶּ֧שֶׂק וְאֶת־חֲמָ֛ת לִיהוּדָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Jeroboam and all that he did and his might, which he waged war, and which he restored Damascus and Hamath to Judah in Israel, [are] not they written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of the kings of Israel?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he restored Damascus and Hamath to Judah in Israel, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, all that he did, his might, how he fought, and how he won back for Israel Damascus and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
en.R: Everything else Jeroboam did is written in the history of the kings of Israel. It tells about his great deeds and his wars. It also tells how he won back Damascus and Hamath for Israel, cities that had once belonged to Judah.

es.L: Y los demás hechos de Jeroboam, y todo lo que hizo, y su poderío, cómo hizo la guerra, y cómo restituyó Damasco y Hamat a Judá en Israel, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Jeroboam, todo lo que hizo, su poderío, cómo hizo la guerra y cómo recuperó para Israel Damasco y Hamat, que habían pertenecido a Judá, están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Jeroboam está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Israel. Allí se cuentan sus hazañas y sus guerras. También se cuenta cómo recuperó para Israel Damasco y Hamat, ciudades que antes habían pertenecido a Judá.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Jéroboam, et tout ce qu’il fit, et sa vaillance, comment il combattit et comment il rendit Damas et Hamath à Juda en Israël, n’est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Jéroboam, tout ce qu’il fit, sa vaillance, ses combats, et la manière dont il reconquit pour Israël Damas et Hamath, qui avaient appartenu à Juda, est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout le reste de ce qu’a fait Jéroboam a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël. On y raconte ses exploits et ses guerres. On y raconte aussi comment il a repris Damas et Hamath pour Israël, des villes qui avaient autrefois appartenu à Juda.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Yeroboamu, na yote aliyoyafanya, na nguvu zake, jinsi alivyopigana, na jinsi alivyorudisha Dameski na Hamathi, [zilizokuwa] za Yuda, kwa Israeli, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Yeroboamu, yote aliyoyafanya, nguvu zake, jinsi alivyopigana, na jinsi alivyoirudishia Israeli Dameski na Hamathi, zilizokuwa za Yuda, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyoyafanya Yeroboamu yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Israeli. Huko kuna habari za matendo yake makuu na vita vyake. Pia kuna habari za jinsi alivyoirudishia Israeli miji ya Dameski na Hamathi, iliyokuwa zamani ya Yuda.

vi.L: Các việc khác của Giê-rô-bô-am, mọi điều ông đã làm, sức mạnh của ông, cách ông giao chiến, và cách ông khôi phục Đa-mách và Ha-mát cho Giu-đa trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của Giê-rô-bô-am, mọi điều ông đã làm, sức mạnh của ông, cách ông giao chiến, và cách ông thu hồi cho Y-sơ-ra-ên Đa-mách và Ha-mát, là những thành trước kia thuộc Giu-đa, đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Giê-rô-bô-am đã làm đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Sách ấy kể về những chiến công và các cuộc chiến của ông. Sách cũng kể cách ông giành lại cho Y-sơ-ra-ên Đa-mách và Ha-mát, là những thành trước kia thuộc về Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 여로보암의 나머지 일들과 그가 한 모든 것과 그의 용맹, 곧 그가 싸운 것과 그가 다메섹과 하맛을 유다에 [속했던 것을] 이스라엘에 되돌린 것은 이스라엘 왕들의 날들의 일을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 여로보암의 나머지 행적과 그가 한 모든 일과 그의 용맹, 곧 그가 싸운 일과 유다에 속했던 다메섹과 하맛을 이스라엘에 되찾아 준 일은 이스라엘 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 여로보암이 한 나머지 일은 이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다. 그 책에는 그의 용감한 업적과 그가 벌인 전쟁이 실려 있다. 또 한때 유다에 속했던 다메섹과 하맛을 그가 이스라엘에 되찾아 준 이야기도 실려 있다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Jeroboão, e tudo o que ele fez, e o seu poder, como lutou, e como restituiu Damasco e Hamate a Judá em Israel, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
pt.B: Os demais atos de Jeroboão, tudo o que ele fez, o seu poder, como lutou e como reconquistou para Israel Damasco e Hamate, que tinham pertencido a Judá, estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Jeroboão fez está escrito na história dos reis de Israel. Ali se conta sobre os seus grandes feitos e as suas guerras. Também se conta como ele reconquistou para Israel Damasco e Hamate, cidades que antes tinham pertencido a Judá.

decisions.choice: restored Damascus and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, to Israel
alternatives: restored Damascus and Hamath to Judah and Israel
restored Damascus and Hamath to Israel
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says literally "restored Damascus and Hamath to Judah in Israel", and its sense is not certain. The likeliest reading is that Jeroboam brought under Israel's rule the cities that had once been subject to David's kingdom, ruled from Judah (2 Samuel 8:5-10; 1 Kings 5:1). Others read it as "to Judah and to Israel", or take "Judah" as a copying slip.

decisions.choice: Damascus and Hamath: Aramean cities to the north
decisions.reason: Damascus was the capital of Aram, which had long pressed on Israel (13:3, 22). Hamath lay farther north, on the Orontes river.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel
decisions.reason: As in verse 15.

decisions.choice: a statement in place of the question
decisions.reason: As in verse 15. Balanced and Readable follow the likeliest reading of the hard phrase (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew words.

decisions.choice: "recuperó para Israel Damasco y Hamat, que habían pertenecido a Judá"
alternatives: restituyó Damasco y Hamat a Judá en Israel
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the likeliest reading of the hard phrase, as the English does (m1); Literal keeps its word order.

decisions.choice: jinsi alivyorudisha Dameski na Hamathi, [zilizokuwa] za Yuda, kwa Israeli
alternatives: alivyorudisha Dameski na Hamathi kwa Yuda katika Israeli
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "to Judah in Israel" is hard; Literal follows the reading of meaning decision m1, cities that had belonged to Judah, won back for Israel, with the supplied verb in brackets.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יָֽרָבְעָם֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו עִ֖ם מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ זְכַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Jeroboam with his fathers, with [the] kings of Israel, and reigned Zechariah his son in his place.

en.L: And Jeroboam lay down with his fathers, with the kings of Israel, and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Then Jeroboam rested with his ancestors, the kings of Israel. His son Zechariah became king in his place.
en.R: Then Jeroboam died and joined his ancestors, the kings of Israel. His son Zechariah became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Jeroboam con sus padres, con los reyes de Israel; y reinó en su lugar Zacarías su hijo.
es.B: Jeroboam descansó con sus antepasados, los reyes de Israel. Su hijo Zacarías reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Jeroboam murió y se reunió con sus antepasados, los reyes de Israel. Su hijo Zacarías lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Jéroboam se coucha avec ses pères, avec les rois d’Israël, et Zacharie son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Puis Jéroboam reposa avec ses ancêtres, les rois d’Israël. Son fils Zacharie régna à sa place.
fr.R: Puis Jéroboam est mort et il a rejoint ses ancêtres, les rois d’Israël. Son fils Zacharie est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Naye Yeroboamu akalala pamoja na baba zake, pamoja na wafalme wa Israeli, na Zekaria mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Kisha Yeroboamu alipumzika pamoja na babu zake, wafalme wa Israeli. Na mwanawe Zekaria akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Kisha Yeroboamu alikufa, akaungana na babu zake, wafalme wa Israeli. Na mwanawe Zekaria akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Giê-rô-bô-am nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, với các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên; Xa-cha-ri con trai ông trị vì thay ông.
vi.B: Rồi Giê-rô-bô-am an giấc cùng tổ tiên, là các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Xa-cha-ri con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Rồi Giê-rô-bô-am qua đời và về với tổ tiên, là các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Xa-cha-ri con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 여로보암이 그의 조상들, 곧 이스라엘 왕들과 함께 누웠고, 그의 아들 스가랴가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 여로보암은 그의 조상들인 이스라엘 왕들과 함께 잠들었다. 그의 아들 스가랴가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 여로보암은 죽어서 그의 조상들인 이스라엘 왕들 곁으로 갔다. 그의 아들 스가랴가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Jeroboão descansou com os seus pais, com os reis de Israel, e Zacarias, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Então Jeroboão descansou com os seus antepassados, os reis de Israel. E o seu filho Zacarias reinou em seu lugar.
pt.R: Então Jeroboão morreu e se juntou aos seus antepassados, os reis de Israel. O seu filho Zacarias se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers, with the kings of Israel: died and joined the kings before him
decisions.reason: The death formula, as in verse 16. Here it adds "with the kings of Israel" and names no place of burial.

decisions.choice: Zechariah his son: the last of Jehu's line
decisions.reason: Zechariah reigned only six months before he was killed (15:8-12). With him the four generations promised to Jehu came to an end (10:30; 15:12).

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula as throughout Kings. Readable adds "joined his ancestors, the kings of Israel" to keep the words "with the kings of Israel".
